title: Kusanagi Nene — Card Story

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Finally, it's lunch break... Now I can continue the video.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Professional troupe members can sing and dance so well...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The way they say their lines makes them so easy to catch... I'm still a long way off...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe I should do more vocal training after our practice sessions on the stage...hm?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel like someone's staring at me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh gosh... I didn't notice him in front at all...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What are you watching?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(H-He talked!
Even though I've never really seen him talk much to anyone before...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It's a musical...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Uh... He's still looking.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(So much pressure...
I can't concentrate on the video like this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Do you like it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. The music.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I want to focus...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here, take this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you want me to recycle this? Oh, there's a note inside.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I get distracted when there's someone's around.
Search for it and watch it yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya! You not gonna go buy lunch?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Coming.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem, but...did that girl just throw a piece of paper trash at you just now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, you've got it wrong. She was just...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That should have gotten rid of the nuisance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe I'll just watch it quietly with earphones...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh. I should have done that right from the start...
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He said to meet here, but he's not here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hey, hope I didn't keep you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You did. I was waiting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sorry about that. I almost ran into Tsukasa on the way here and had to shake him off. So, how can I help?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, you brought Robo-Nene along today?
Did anyone question you about it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No. I came to school earlier and hid it in an inconspicuous spot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Its arms aren't working very well.
Can you fix that for me? Without Robo-Nene, I...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's no trouble at all.
That's why I brought my tools to school today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? How did you do that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe, the hall monitor would have a fit if I'd brought them in openly, so I exercised some ingenuity to make them fit under my clothes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right... Well, do you think it can be fixed?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll take a look now. Just a moment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The arms, right? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The gears are... Ah, I see the problem now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry. The connections were a little loose, that's all. It should take no time at all to fix them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh. That's great.
Thanks for the help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I've been thinking of how to present the scenes in the script that Tsukasa came up with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you think about singing and breathing fire at the same time?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And who's going to be doing that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, of course, since he's the lead.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It was nice knowing you, Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah... Achoo!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember that scene where the prince puts the dragon to sleep by singing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. Though I doubt his loud and jarring singing can ever put anything to sleep...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You may be right.
So why don't you sing during that part instead?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There won't be any sound except for the actor's voice here. I want the audience to just focus on listening to the song.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, it's not set in stone yet since we have to discuss it with the others first. Perhaps you can simply keep that idea in the back of your mind for now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can I...use Robo-Nene for that part?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll leave that up to you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I've fixed it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah! Already?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I said it'd take no time at all, didn't I?
Here, try operating it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. It's working fine now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now, I'll be okay even if I have to sing...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, now that I've fixed the robot,
it's time for me to go look for Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder how he'll react to that idea from just now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui... You seem happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Really, is that how I come across to you?
Oh, isn't that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, what impeccable timing.
Tsukasa! Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was great! Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Bye.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll stay a bit longer to practice on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's get you over there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Robo-Nene, you'll be my audience.
I'll sing for you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(That went well.
No stage fright at all...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But can I sing like this when the audience is actually filled with real people? What if I forget the lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you enjoyed my song!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm no longer afraid of performing on stage, but that's only thanks to you, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Without you next to me, I lose confidence again...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm, this explains a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So that's why you kept bringing Robo-Nene here, even though she's already served her original purpose.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You... You were spying on me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, like the phantom of the opera, I appear unexpectedly.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So the answer is yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I do apologize for eavesdropping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps I can buy your forgiveness with this can of your favorite grapefruit juice?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You think my forgiveness is that cheap?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I was hoping for a buddy discount.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Jokes aside...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm pleased that you've been taking such good care of Robo-Nene even though we haven't been using her for our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's already accomplished the mission I had set out for her when I built her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it seems it's too early to retire her. She's still needed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a proposition. You would have to let me take her from you for a short while, though. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you planning to do? Modify her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No. I just want to implement some upgrades.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What sort?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She has high functionality, but improvements could be made to usability.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking of making it so that you could operate Robo-Nene while performing on stage alongside her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't mind doing that for me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course not. As the stage director, I'm happy to make any necessary accommodations for my troupe to perform at the best of their ability.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmph...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just remember I won't like it if you add any weird functions to her.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's start our planning meeting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want our next show to feature innovative elements never before seen on stage! So, let's get brainstorming!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How about, how about we all fly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That gets points for showiness, but not for innovation. Give me something better than this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, then... A show where we EXPLODE!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And why would we want to do that?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Because then everyone will have a blast!
And we can have colorful smoke and effects!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to explode into a red cloud of smoke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
If anything, I'd be getting red smoke.
Since ancient times, red has been the color reserved for leaders!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Emu, having the stage filled with smoke would make it impossible for the audience to see anything! And for this reason, I must reject this idea too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Has anyone else got anything?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, I—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me, me!
Same idea but without the smoke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Forget about explosions, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: AHEM...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems Nene has a suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But—ngh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Did he just shove a donut into Emu's mouth so fast my eyes couldn't follow?!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mmm? Nom nom...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He didn't need to shut Emu up for me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui has taken Robo-Nene for upgrades...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And once they're complete, I'd like to perform together with her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa will probably shoot down my suggestion because he wouldn't want Robo-Nene to steal his spotlight.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, so we'd be using Robo-Nene for our next play. But what sort of performance do you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That...was a more positive reaction than I was expecting.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well that... That depends on what upgrades Rui is going to give her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I might offer my suggestion, the play could begin with only Robo-Nene on stage...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm, yeah! That's cool!
Let's tumble with this idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's let's roll with, not tumble!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyhow, I like the novelty of it.
You got me on board.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's...cool.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to see Robo-Nene Version 2.0!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Be patient. It'll be worth the wait.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Go ahead and give her all the upgrades you can think of, but she's not going to outshine me, for I am the true star!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The brightest star in the constellation of Goofus.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: G-Goofus?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And since you're relatively cool... You're a red dwarf! Rufous Goofus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I...don't want to be called that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A clever rhyme, Emu. Rufous Goofus has a nice ring to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Can you please stop!
It sounds dumb!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's why it suits you perfectly, Rufous Goofus...Doofus.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How dare you!
And don't add to it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rufous Goofus, Rufous Doofus♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't make it into a song!
Stop dancing to it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I've just thought of something!
Why don't we incorporate dances from around the world into this scene?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Dances from around the world? Why?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It perfectly portrays the character of Prince Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Prince Pegasus acts for the sake of world peace, remember? Featuring dances from around the world would be one way to express that! What do you think of this great idea of mine?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There he goes with his nonsensical talk again...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, that sounds fun!
Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm glad we see eye to eye!
That's decided then! We'll incorporate dances from around the world!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And the other one only wants to do what sounds fun...)

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... I don't mind, but can you be a bit more specific about the exact kind of dances you want to include?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll think about that now!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: So you were just blurting out whatever came to your mind?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Dances from around the world... In that case, folk dances like flamenco and hopak may be good options to consider. The Bharatanatyam may be an interesting addition too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We could change our background music too.
Something like czardas or mazurka would fit nicely.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! That sounds super fun!
Let's try all that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, Emu... Do you know those dances he mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nopes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then why...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How about you, Nene? Do you know them?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I know flamenco and hopak, but not the others...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Bharatanatyam is an Indian classical dance, one of the four major classical dances, in fact.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Czardas and mazurka are musical styles that were popular during the 19th century. They were both used in Coppelia—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Did you just say Coppelia?!
That makes them songs that are just perfect for me! Excellent! We'll use them!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Coppelia, as in, that Coppelia?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Copyleer?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Coppelia is a comic ballet that was created in the 19th century and still beloved by many audiences today.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I'm a little surprised you actually know your stuff. Then show us how the dance goes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? I don't remember the exact moves...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then just move as I tell you to, alright?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Well, I can do that, yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, Emu, go down and watch us from the front of the stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Will do!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First of all, raise both arms.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. Next, draw a semicircle with your left arm as you put your right arm on your waist.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woooow!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Pfft...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Th-This isn't a ballet move...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, move your right hand next to your face, clench your fist, and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Transform into Gutsman!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Correct, Emu.
That was a perfect Gutsman pose.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excuse me?!
What were you trying to make me do, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hehe... People usually...hehe...realize what's going on halfway through, you know. Are you dumb? Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I only followed his instructions because you said you wanted to see the dance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm next! I wanna do it too!
Watch me go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You don't have to! Let's just focus on the script instead! Hey, Nene...I mean, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop sitting there and come back onto the stage already! We need to continue discussing the script.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do the Gutsman pose together, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Forget Gutsman already!
Hurry up and come over!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He wasn't very keen on having a robot around at first, but now he treats not me, but Robo-Nene as an official member of the troupe.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's such a strange fool...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Robo-Nene! Did you hear me?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Once is enough!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yeeeah.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Hello.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ah! Nene!
Hi ho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? You're alone today?
Where are Tsukasa and Rui?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They, um, will be late because of detention, so yes, I came here by myself...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Both of them have detention together?
Do I smell an incident?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa almost got blown up in the swimming pool... He's fine, but the explosion created a plume of water. Because of that, they had to stay back for detention.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Explosions and plumes of water?!
That sounds so fun! I'll have to ask them about it later!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, let's get the place ready while we wait for them! Starting with the cleanup!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah, okay, I just have to wipe the floor...right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Thanks!
Oh, and don't mind that creaky spot over there♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, got it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? This stain won't come off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's been there for a long time. It won't come off!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Has this line stain been here for a long time too?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that too! I've tried a few different methods to remove them, but they just won't go away.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm... It may be time to apply some wax over the floor. The coating over there has come off. We'll need to fix it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Emu is so serious about this...
Come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This place is important to you and your grandfather, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's right!
Grandpa was the one who made this stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've watched so many shows here and saw it transform into all sorts of different worlds before and after the performances!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Different worlds...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! That's why I want to keep putting big, bright smiles on people's faces from the worlds we create on this stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is that...your dream?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
What about you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's your dream to become a musical actress, right? What made you have that dream?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, I guess... It was because of the musical Rui and I watched together when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was so moved by that musical because everything inside, from the singing to the dancing and acting was amazing. I wanted to be able to sing and dance like that one day too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! And that's why you wanted to become a stage actress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes... Rui also started wanting to become a stage director because of that musical too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sharing the same dream after watching the same show... How wonderhoy-ful is that?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm... When you put it that way, it does seem wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And then?
And then what happened?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Rui and I started learning about stage shows on our own, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, but what did you do, exactly?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We watched different musicals, movies, and tried to put into practice what we had learned...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa... I always thought you sang so well.
So it's because you've been practicing since you were little!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu?
What are you so happy about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm happy because I got to talk so much with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What about you? Are you happy?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. I'm happy too, I think.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A message from...Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<We just ended here.
We're heading over there as quickly as we can now.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What is it? What did he say?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He said they're heading over here now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's fun when everyone practices together, but...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (For now, I hope I can talk to Emu for just a bit longer.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
<You don't have to rush or anything.
Take your time.>
Send.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The next show after Halloween?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, exactly! Since Halloween is already over, we need to start thinking about what our next show is going to be.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought Rui was already planning for that, though?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Some parts haven't been finalized yet, but the general flow is mostly settled. I would love to hear your opinions on what I currently have.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The next show is gonna be about outer space, right?! Where we do the floaty-float and whirly-whirl thing?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Only you and Rui can understand that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, well, to be a bit more specific...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're going to have Tsukasa become an ephemeral star for us in an outer space setting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey... I don't like this feeling I'm getting. What do you mean, ephemeral star? Am I going to be put into a state of suspended animation or something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, you're going to literally become a star in the sky.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That doesn't make any more sense than your last explanation! Also, I'm now more worried than before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There they go again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're back to their normal selves again!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry, Tsukasa. I've taken all the proper safety measures. So rest assured and become the shining star you've always wanted to be.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's not the kind of star I wanted to be!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Heh...what a pair of idiots.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm really happy for Rui.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe he can finally move on from his past now.)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ahh, what a productive practice session that was. We turned Tsukasa into a true star today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes... Literally, just as you said you would.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, it would be a terrible waste for him to be flung so high that the audience can't even see him anymore, so I'll still need to polish up that part a bit more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way. I've come up with a new performance for your big scene as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should be finished with the final touches by today, so can we talk a bit more about that tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh, a message? From Emu?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Let's go to Wonder Stage together after school tomorrow♪>?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're just going for practice together, right? Fine by me.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hm? There's another message...
<I'll go fetch you, so wait for me in the classroom!>?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That reminds me. Emu has been coming over to our school to visit us quite often lately, hasn't she?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She intends to trespass again?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
<Do NOT come inside. Wait at the school gate!>
This should stop her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe... You're not telling her to not come at all, hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? It's not like she'd listen even if I told her that, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is that really all?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you trying to say?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all that's said and done, I can tell you seem to be having a lot of fun yourself recently too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe because you've found a good friend in Emu?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Friend? Feels more like I'm just being led around by her into all sorts of troublesome situations...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You say that, but you're always replying to her messages properly, as troublesome as you claim them to be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: According to my observations, Emu's messages are the only ones you diligently try to reply to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You make it sound as if Emu's my only friend or something...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll have you know that I have plenty of friends that I can talk to.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean friends in the video games you play, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And what's wrong with that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not saying it's wrong to make friends through games.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But for friends like that, you only talk to them about game items and how to maximize grinding efficiency, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh... It doesn't matter what we talking about. The point is we do talk!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Another message from Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?
<Let's have lunch together too!>?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She intends to break into school at lunch hour?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'd better reply her right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Don't you have school friends you can have lunch with? Eat with them!> There.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: An instant reply? Oh, does she ever listen?! Look here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you're definitely having fun any way you slice it.
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Sigh, lunch break at long last.
Hey, where should we go for lunch today?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: How about the courtyard, since the weather's pretty good?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yes, the weather's great, but any time spent moving around is time I can't use to enjoy my lunch break.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Instead, I should use that time to complete some daily missions or spend some stamina in the games that I'm playing...)
Neeeneee♪ Where aaare youuu? Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hm? I've heard that voice somewhere before...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There you are, Nene! Found you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe, here I am♪
Let's have lunch together, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh... No... Whaaaaaat?!
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I was so surprised, Nene!
I've never heard you shriek so loudly before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't know I had it in me either...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Sigh... I'm so surprised that my heart is still beating
so quickly.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have so many questions, like what're you doing here? Outsiders aren't allowed on school grounds, you know? But...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's have lunch together♪
I'm sooo hungry!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yup, it's not like she's going to get the hint, and it'll just make me more tired, so I guess that's that.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay... I don't think anyone will be coming to the rooftop, so we should be safe here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(There's nothing I can do today, I guess...
But she's really going to get caught and scolded by the teachers one day.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, since we've already found our lunch spot, I'll call Miku out now♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yaaay♪ Hi ho, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, we're having lunch with Nene today, right?
Hi Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?
Why is she appearing like it's completely normal?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? You didn't know, Nene? If you have a smartphone capable of playing holograms, you can have a normal conversation with Miku like this!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup yup! I can totally appear on your smartphone too, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Just wait for it...
And now I'm saying hello from Nene's smartphone!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow, you're right...
No wait, that's not what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, when did you start talking with Miku like this, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let me see... When she came to cheer me on during my school's sports day, I think♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <After that, Emu told me I was welcome to visit her at school anytime, and so I did♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Does that mean you can appear like this on anybody's smartphone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Nah, only from smartphones loaded with songs that were born from true feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, someone else is here? Let's get them to have lunch with us too! Food always tastes better when we eat them together with someone else♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, we can't let people find out that there's an outsider in the school! You need to hide, quickly—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! I knew I heard her voice!
Emu, what're you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eh, Tsukasa?
And Rui too? But how come?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa and Rui!
Yahohoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yahohoy yourself! Do you know what you've done?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uhh, am I not welcome here? It's so sad that I'm the only one in a different school, and I only wanted to have lunch together with Nene...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... I mean I understand how you feel, but it's still not good to break into another school like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we all gather at SEKAI for lunch?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Considering the short travel time and lower risk of being discovered by the teachers, it's a lot better to eat there, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's a great idea, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright♪ Now I can always have lunch together with Nene and Tsukasa and Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Us too?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course! And if we're all together, we can talk about our shows too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Lunch is starting to sound very entertaining now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Emu looks happy about this. I'm always eating lunch alone anyway, so it doesn't matter if I have it at school or in SEKAI, I guess...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But why does she want to eat lunch with me so much?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm not going to ask her, though, it's too embarrassing... I could just be overthinking this, anyway.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh... I know. I could send a message.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then I was like—ah, hang on. I just got a message.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh?! Hehehe♪
You get an immediate reply♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hm? She replied already.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Because Nene is a dear friend of mine!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A dear...friend...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (You already have so many other friends, though...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this feels kind of nice, I guess.)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, the next scene is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene! Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Miku? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your School Festival is coming up, right? Tsukasa's class is doing a play, but what about your class?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, uh... We're running a cotton candy stall.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? That sounds fun too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, um... I guess.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It would be fun if it didn't involve dealing with customers... I wish we picked something easier.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Sigh... I'm not looking forward to practicing how to make cotton candy tomorrow either. Maybe I can just skip it...)
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
We're going to split into two groups.
Girls over here please!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I couldn't come up with a good excuse and now I'm stuck here...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: We'll start by making bear-shaped cotton candy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right... It's not just regular cotton candy, but animal-shaped cotton candy.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The example in the book looks really cute, but can I really make something like this?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I did it?! Sticking to the instructions really helped.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wow! Nice job, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's so cute!
Our customers are gonna love it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe this is a little fun...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Done...

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Whoa! Was Toya born to make cotton candy?! This is perfect!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The boys are getting all excited too.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Whoa! Aoyagi's really good at this.
We can't let them outdo us!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Phew! That was fun!
I think I'm getting the hang of it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah. It takes a while to make even just one.
We might have to make a bunch in advance.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: That sounds good. Having lots of different ones on display should attract more customers too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They all seem like they're having fun...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This atmosphere has the same feel as when we're preparing our shows...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a good idea! I mean, who can resist trying one of these adorable cotton candy creatures?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hey, no eating the product!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: And screwing up on purpose too!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They care so much about our stall being successful. I feel like I should make a bit of an effort too.)
School Festival - The day of

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh... Hi, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-Is something wrong?
You look pale. Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Um... One of our cotton candy machines...! It's busted...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh no... And we were just about to get started making the candy!)

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: I have an idea! Let's ask Kamishiro and see if he can fix it! He's the guy that makes robots and drones, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yes...! That should be easy for Rui!)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I-I don't want to be the one to ask him. He's a second year, and I heard he's a creep who uses his drones to spy on other students!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Let's just start making the candy with the other machine. Otherwise, we won't have anything ready in time!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: We can't make enough with just one machine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I need to speak up...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wow, you're good at it, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's so cute!
Our customers are gonna love it!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I, um... I know Kamishiro, so...!
I'll go ask him if he can help!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There. All done.
It won't give you any more trouble.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's great...!
Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're welcome. But I must leave you now.
Tsukasa wanted to see me too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure. And thanks again!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew, I'm so relieved...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Thanks for getting Rui to repair the cotton candy machine for us! We can open our stall now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
We can't thank you enough, Kusanagi!
You're Class 1-B's savior!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It's not a big deal... It was Kamishiro who fixed the machine anyway. I just called him here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was looking forward to running this stall with everyone too so...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Alright, guys! Let's open for business!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm glad they're all smiling again...)
A few days after the School Festival
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, it's high time we started planning our next performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's do it☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It feels like it's been forever since we last met up to plan something together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The School Festival kept us all busy so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, raise your hand if you have any suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me! Me! Me!
Can we do a show about animals?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A story about animals maybe...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! There can be this one animal who's all by itself but it'll go on an adventure to fight a bad guy and make lots of friends along the way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm. It's pretty orthodox, but it could work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a nice story, but the structure is very similar to our previous shows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We've done some before where the protagonist defeats baddies and finds happiness.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Simple stories that are easy to follow are well-suited for children, but they might lose interest if we keep reusing the same ideas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, how about we add more protagonists?
Like in my class play about Romeos.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You just had a lot of people called Romeo in that and you were the only actual protagonist.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I do like the idea of a play with multiple protagonists and parallel storylines.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh! That is another way of doing it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, if we have too many characters, we risk overwhelming our young audience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may help to go with a motif that they're already familiar with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Something familiar...
Maybe more realistic and less fantastic...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Something real... For me, that's going to school, rehearsing here or in SEKAI, then going home and playing games...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No... There's nothing exciting about just staying indoors.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Something else that's familiar, but a little out of the ordinary... The School Festival is the most recent thing that comes to mind...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, duh... The School Festival...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Did you just have a eureka moment, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It isn't that spectacular but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was thinking about school, the School Festival or some other festival. Something that most kids would be familiar with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... For example, there could be this one kid with some kind of problem, like being lonely or wanting their family to make up after an argument...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But while they're preparing something for the festival, they make new friends and maybe have some small fights, but it all works out for them in the end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, wow! That's an awesome story!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it's even simple enough for little kids to understand!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But hold on... Is it just me or does it sound too plain for us, especially compared to what we've been doing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps we could make it more interesting by having it take place at a school of magic?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we keep it simple, I think the kids will enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Magic is unusual and inexplicable, but it's a familiar and exciting concept to them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui, that's genius! Then let's do a show about a school of magic's School Festival!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... We're really doing this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, what's this now? It was your own suggestion!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, we've got the basics down.
Now to hammer out the details!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Th-They're really going with my suggestion...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh, I know! Since it's a school festival, we'll need lots and lots of stalls!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good idea! We could set them up both on stage and around the audience seats. How about that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would also be nice if some of them were actual shops and not just decorative. That way, the audience could take part in the play as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It might be even more fun if you could get different stuff each day or week...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, do you have anything you'd like to add?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't be shy.
It's your story after all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I-I was just about to say something, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everything is starting to turn out nicely thanks to you, Nene. But well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I was just thinking that you must've really enjoyed the School Festival to propose this idea. Hehe. I'm glad I fixed that cotton candy machine now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay. I mean, it only took you a few minutes to get it going again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nene! I'm going to start writing the script.
I need some more input from you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? But I already told you everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That couldn't have been everything! This is your chance to make yourself heard and create your very own play. Don't pass it up!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What happened to his overblown ego? He's always so pushy about putting what he wants in the script.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Fine, I'll see what else I can think of...
But you need to contribute too, okay...?
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The first day of our Christmas show went pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, but we can't get complacent.
Especially with the Phoenix Stage troupe's lead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Let's keep this momentum and leave them in the dust!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And let's make sure lots and lots of people smile after seeing our show☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's the plan! And I've got an idea that can help us achieve that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A plan?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, you overcame your fears and learned to unleash your true potential.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, it's time for the rest of us to break out of our shells and spread our wings!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I knew it'd be something dumb...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! If we want to break out of our shells, we can start by becoming eggs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't hijack the conversation just to have it get derailed even more!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. A play where we all act like we've turned into eggs could be very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! Rui, don't side with her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Was my plan hatched too prematurely? What if the things that come out of it are more chaotic versions of them...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You made it sound easy, Tsukasa, but...
How do you suggest we actually do that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's... Uh, something for all of us to think about!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... It would need to have an immediate effect for our Christmas show to benefit from it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means... We should try overcoming something that's been challenging to us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would build our confidence and make us more resilient. It may even enable us to perform at our best under any circumstances.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yikes. That look in Rui's eyes... He's definitely plotting something weird. We might be better off practicing as usual.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But overcoming personal difficulties is no easy matter. I don't think we have the time for this now, so let's just keep doing things the way we have been for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good thinking, Rui! Then improving the quality of our shows will surely allow us to grow as actors!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! I like your idea too! The better we all get, the more smiles we can bring♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Guys, you can't be serious...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Since most of us are for it, I'll go and get what we'll need. Wait here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I tried stopping him... No one can blame me for what happens now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oof! There...
Sorry for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's a fairly hefty box...
What's in it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A surprise.
Why don't you see for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay. Let's get it open... A-Aaargh!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, gross. Centipedes, spiders...
Are these all just toy bugs...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's right.
I wanted to use them for the Halloween show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We went with a zombie theme in the end, so I didn't get any use of them... Hehe. Until now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They didn't need to see daylight, ever! Is this what you meant by overcoming challenges?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. You're scared of bugs, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and he's particularly afraid of ones with many legs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? Where are you going, Tsukasa? Don't you want to break out of your shell and unlock your true potential?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have to become masters of our own fears if we are to stage the most wonderful of shows!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wow, Rui's sadistically enjoying Tsukasa's misery...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's cure your phobia, Tsukasa!
It's time for... A bug shower!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Gyaaah!
Not all at once!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eek! Get away...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to get away from Tsukasa or they'll get on me too! Oh, I know!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Robo-Nene! Protect me!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Nene, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. Shield me from the bugs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! No fair, Nene!
Protect me too...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Get away from me, you idiot!
You're the target here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I only brought something for Tsukasa this time, and I wouldn't want you to get bored, Emu. Would you mind helping me cure his phobia?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sure, I'm on it! Ready... Aim... Fire!
It's raining creepy crawlies, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: Nooooo!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... I can't take it... Anymore...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You guys, we're high schoolers...
Why are we playing dumb kiddie games like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! That was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe for you! It was hellish for me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see an opening. Take that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gyaaah! Not another centipede!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it looks like you weren't able to overcome your fears this time. We'll have to think of another way to help you break out of your shell.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! Let's put wings on these and fly them at Tsukasa like they're really alive!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
NO!
Stop making my trauma worse!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Sigh... These guys are so dumb...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But maybe the crazy stuff they get up to is a little fun sometimes...)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No one else should be here so...
Okay, all clear.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I am a little sad that the Christmas show's over already...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But standing on the stage... I remember every moment of it and still feel it inside me. I can almost hear the audience laughing and applauding...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really managed to sing like I used to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It might even be my favorite play that I've done so far...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was so much fun...
It almost seemed like a dream.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright.
Robo-Nene, you'll be my audience as usual...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep! Roger.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our stage may look like something that could get blown away by a strong breeze, but our shows are the crème de la crème!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you're wrong if you think Nene can't sing as well as you!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(After Tsukasa said that about me,
I just had to prove him right.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The only way we should get revenge is by putting on an amazing show that knocks her socks off!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa took me to a play when I was little and it was like a really amazing dream!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also saw my first play with my family. My sister was in poor health back then, but that day she felt well enough to go out. She was so happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She loved the play so much, I decided to become an actor so that I could cheer her up like that too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All those memories are flooding back...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I just came by to make sure you were okay, and I'm happy to see you're back in high spirits!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Me too! It's a weight off my mind to see you've overcome your slump.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Miku and MEIKO showed me that they really cared about me too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'm fine now. I have nothing to fear.
I'm no longer all by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have this crazy troupe of troublemakers...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (At first, I couldn't really get myself to go along with their antics...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But then I realized I'd be missing out if I didn't take part in their ridiculously weird shows.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now, I'm one of them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I never imagined things would turn out this way.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They'd better take responsibility for all this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene!! That was great!
You were so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was your best song yet!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You should have invited us to your performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What... Wh-When did you all get here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just when you started really getting into it. You were singing with so much joy, we all just stopped and listened.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even Emu managed to stay quiet until you finished.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, Nene's singing is just so beautiful♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You heard all of it...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm so embarrassed, I don't want them to look at me! I know, I'll hide behind Robo-Nene!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Robo-Nene... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, did you enjoy Nene's song too?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, I did! Nene, your singing is amazing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't want applause. Just hide me!
Your arms are too short to clap anyway!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were singing so confidently. Don't get all shy on us now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Be proud, Nene! You're just as good if not better than that girl from the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was just... Surprised to see you all and wasn't expecting an audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't care about being called a diva or whatever. But since we're all performing together, try not to embarrass me on stage, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you saying? Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's all keep having fun doing shows together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For sure...!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu really just left.
I wonder if she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sorry about my brothers, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing that serious...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Just a little fight! Don't worry! We've made up already too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really okay now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: With her gone, we can't actually do any talking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose we should call it a day as well then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, excuse me. I think I left something at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, would you mind going ahead without me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uh, sure...? I'll be fine by myself.
Bye.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What part of that is okay?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Why won't she tell us anything...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to do?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...! Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good evening. Are you on your way home from PXL?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I am. Is that your guitar case, Hoshino? So that means...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm heading home too. We rented a studio for our practice today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me if I'm mistaken but...
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uh...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If... If you don't mind, would you like to sit down and talk at the park?
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is nice and quiet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, I'm not trying to force you into talking or anything but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, I thought I'd lend you an ear so that you might feel a little better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She seems so worried. Maybe I should tell her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, but... She goes to the same school as Emu...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't want her to worry about Emu either, so maybe I can tell her in a way that it's not obvious who I'm talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... There's just something I heard about this girl I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's always being obnoxious to her friends, but usually has a lot of energy and a smile on her face...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But lately, she's been preoccupied with something having to do with her family...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And her friends feel like they're not really in a position to say anything or butt into their business...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In the end, I... They just haven't been able to help her at all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This girl means a lot to... Your friend.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Conversely, you may want to think about what exactly you want to do instead of how she feels...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What I want to do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Um, this is about... Someone I know too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This person has these friends they've known since they were little and were very close until middle school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But around their second year, one of these friends started to feel really down or depressed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So this person asked their friend if something was wrong, but they were just told it was nothing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And then...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The same situation as us...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They were so worried about their friend, but weren't really able to muster up the courage to do much in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And they felt so sorry, so much regret over letting their friend go through that on their own... A lot of regret...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi... I understand why someone in that position would hesitate the way they are...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But if you do nothing while they remain lost... Who might feel the worst in the end?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neeeneee♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She always says or does weird stuff, and gets everyone mixed into her antics...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I've enjoyed every minute of it so far...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I want Emu to keep doing outrageous things with Tsukasa. I want her to keep concocting crazy ideas with Rui. And...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I want her to laugh and smile like always...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm not sure what I should be doing right now, but I think I have an idea...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino, thank you for listening. And for telling me about your friend too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope you'll be able to help your friend.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too.
After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Today's the day we head to SEKAI to start planning our strategy...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (How we can save Phoenix Wonderland as Emu would like while not having to make some deal with another company.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But a real business plan might be pretty challenging...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This park may very well be struggling financially, but it would be all for naught if the park ended up folding by operating the way it has been...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So we need a way to make sure Phoenix Wonderland can stay afloat while maintaining its current image...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We have to do everything we can for Emu's sake too...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Emu also mentioned that she'll come over here once school was over too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think Tsukasa even told her to wait outside by the gate, but I'm sure she'll just barge in like always.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A message? Who could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, it's Hoshino...
<I'd like to practice with you again...>)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We made some progress with Emu, and I'd like to pay her back for what she did for me the other day.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
<I should be free the day after tomorrow and during the next holiday.>
And send...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, you're still in your classroom.
It's almost time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I know. Just give me a...
I'm heeere!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that has to be...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
None other than Emu.
She's already here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? But I don't see anyone matching her description by the school gate...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may just be that she wants to greet everyone or everything she comes across.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, but that means... What do we do if she gets caught by a teacher?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good question. However, we should be fine. Emu should only be going to one of two places.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? One of two?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She visits our school fairly often, but she only knows where your class is along with Tsukasa's.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? Wait, doesn't she know where your class is too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She does. But since my class is right next to Tsukasa's, there's no logical reason for her to go there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we head over to Tsukasa's class, while keeping an eye out for her in the meantime?
Kamiyama High School - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everything was pretty quiet on the way over here, so where could she have gone?)

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher's Voice
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, it's you lot.
Not going home yet?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? A teacher?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh dear... This may be bad, but let's observe a bit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh! There's Emu hiding behind Tsukasa under a desk.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But the teacher hasn't noticed her yet, I don't think. If Tsukasa can keep them busy somehow and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wh-What are you doing, Emu?! Tsukasa was actually doing a good job...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may need to step in here. Nene, if you don't mind coming over here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can stay out of sight here and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Just follow my lead.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Follow your lead...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fight! Check it out! The baseball team's really going at each other's throats!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, okay. Now I get it.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Someone! Get a teacher!

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher's Voice
rows.Line:
A fight?! We need to stop them!
Tenma, go home! Now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How was that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And... They're gone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You could've told me you were going to do that, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? But you did splendidly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe you came up with the best line possible there, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Hehehe. That was sooo much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Fun?! Do you even know how to play hide and seek?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh geez...
Those two must be in a good mood if they're being this loud.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this is how things should be...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, shall we head over to SEKAI with them before a teacher finds us out?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Sounds good.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hi, Kusanagi.
Thanks for coming.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sure...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This girl means a lot to... Your friend.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Conversely, you may want to think about what exactly you want to do instead of how she feels...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi... I understand why someone in that position would hesitate the way they are...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But if you do nothing while they remain lost... Who might feel the worst in the end?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I should thank Hoshino giving me that advice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... About that friend I told you about the other day, she seems much better now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really...? Hehe. I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and thank you for that advice you gave me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm really glad I asked you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're very welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You've been helping me with my singing like this, so I'm glad that I was able to give back a little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, her voice sounds much more stable through that section now. She's even breathing and controlling her volume better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's going into the chorus much smoother too. She must've practiced a lot...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... How was that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was good.
All that's left are the finer details, like making sure your state of mind matches the lyrics you're singing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like how I feel when I'm singing? Okay, I'll try working on that for next time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Great.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I have a feeling that you're not singing as well as you usually can... Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you sing more normally, it might actually sound better... I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (When I was teaching them what to do, I just thought about practicing with Hoshino and managed to get through to them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But was that really the right way to put it? They might've been able to sing better if I actually knew what to say then...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, no! It's nothing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But... You have a lot of fond memories of Phoenix Wonderland too, right, Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I do. Saki, my friends and I used to go there often when we were kids. My family too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about you, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me? Um... I never had a chance to go because I was in a children's theatre company...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I think Emu's right. It sounds like a lot of people really do care about Phoenix Wonderland...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (For the sake of the park and all of its fans, our next show has to succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But can that really happen with me having to tell so many people what to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyways, shall we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, wait! There's one thing I need to ask you...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Does the way I teach make it hard for you to understand stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thing is... I have to teach people from Phoenix Wonderland's other troupes how to sing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?! That's great, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I'm not sure it is...
I'm so worried that I'm not doing a good job...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sorry if this is too sudden. I get that it's my own problem and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No.
But I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really like the way you teach. Every piece of advice you've given me has been spot on so far.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You make everything so easy to learn by explaining how to sing which kinds of songs and even singing along to help me understand it better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I am proof that what you do works!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, that's because you have such a good work ethic...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you've even talked about how I should be practicing and what to look out for. You did all of that, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're the reason why I've been able to try so hard and really believe in myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So you should believe in what you're doing too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. If you're willing to say that much, maybe I should have more confidence in myself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, you should...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, Hoshino.
You got to be the teacher today for a change.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't actually mean to...

Oh, I've seen this theatre on TV before...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? But I don't recognize the one next to it. I wonder what's playing there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?!
Pe... “Pegasus Odyssey”...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
And what's with this poster?
It's pretty much just a giant picture of Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... SEKAI was initially born out mostly of Tsukasa's feelings, so is this an extension of that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I was the lead for our Christmas show and the Little Mermaid...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Shouldn't those be here too...
Lemme see...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aha, found it...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There we go. The Christmas show, that Halloween show we did and the Little Mermaid.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This is so cool...
Posters of me on Broadway...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hang on, none of this is real.
What am I getting all worked up for...?

<Don't look down. Look up at the sky.
See? There's a beautiful rainbow!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: <Would you like to fly into the sky with me?>

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: <Don't be afraid. Believe in yourself!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew it. It's me when I was little rehearsing for that show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this video's supposed to be at my house... So what, anything goes at this point?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, this reminds me of that Christmas show we did...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I love theatre...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm gonna sing my heart out no matter what. I'm not gonna worry so much about trying not to mess up or beating Sakurako...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have Tsukasa, Emu, Rui, Miku and everyone else to thank for making me realize that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're all on my side so...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? Another video...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka's Voice
rows.Line: <Most others laughed at me when I told them about how I wanted to do shows around the world, but this troupe didn't.>

rows.Speaker: Yuka's Voice
rows.Line: <Which is why leaving them was so hard...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What happened...?
Why is this playing now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm here because of them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I...
I can't do anything without...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... I'm back?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, Nene, it's you. I was wondering if someone had come by. But what are you doing here so late?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see...
Now I understand...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What you found was likely a fragment of somebody's feelings...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A fragment of somebody's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you see... In SEKAI, fragments of feelings that are yet to manifest as a SEKAI of their own can appear here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By approaching it, you're able to access some of the feelings that are stored inside.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. So it wasn't a prank or anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still...
Somebody's feelings...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Based on where I was and what I saw, I'm inclined to believe that those were my feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Um, Nene.
I'd like to ask you a question.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's purely hypothetical but founded on that fragment coming from your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, go on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A part of you is happy about how much you've grown and appreciated everything everyone in Wonderlands×Showtime has done for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Another part of you still dreams of becoming a globe-trotting actress just like your hero.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And there's a part of you that doesn't want to leave your friends behind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You felt all these things while over there, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I did...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe you experienced what you did because your mind isn't made up yet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To be fair, I didn't actually feel what you felt, so I can't exactly say for sure...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that's my guess based on what you told me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My mind isn't made up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would it be better for me in terms of acting to be able to make quicker decisions...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Doubt and hesitation are both evidence of a person trying to face what they're feeling.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's just another way to move forward...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, Nene, I don't want you to regret making any decisions.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My guess is that what you're feeling in your heart right now is going to play an incredibly important role in your life from here on out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I believe you should think long and hard about which path you ultimately wish to take.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I'll be there to help you every step of the way♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I promise to do just that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My dream in life versus wanting to grow alongside Tsukasa, Emu and Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Making a decision won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I want to find the right answer and be able to say it without hesitating.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, that would be wonderful♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I don't think you have anything to worry about, Nene. I'm sure you'll find the answer you're looking for.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks!
The day of the U.S. trip
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh where, oh where could Tsukasa be♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He said that he'd forgotten to bring a change of clothes and had to head home, but he should've returned by now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Honestly, who forgets to bring extra sets of clothes on a trip? It's not like he left home with just his passport, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: I'm baaaack!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, there he is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I... I made it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Welcome back. Do you have everything you need now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Just in case...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm set for clothes. My passport's in my bag, and I have a transformer for my phone... Okay.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I take it you have everything you need as well, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Wh-What are you talking about?
Why are you asking?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But! I was so surprised when I first heard that we'd be going to the United States.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, me too☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As in the United States of America?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Because we're partnering with his company, Mr. Riley said, “You should come learn more about our park and characters by seeing them for yourselves.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's very kind of him.
We'll get to visit one of the most famous theme parks in the world.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! You can see all the characters from the movies at Mr. Riley's park, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
