rows.Line: I mean, each area's supposed to be based on Riley Entertainment's most famous movies, so I'm sure you'll get to see characters from each franchise.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like “The Little Kingdom”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You seem to know an awful lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's still your favorite, isn't it, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I really love the theme song, but the music and insert songs for each of the characters are just as amazing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... I'm wondering if we'll get to hear some of them during shows while we're over there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm also looking forward to that. They may be the same songs, but they supposedly sound and feel different when heard in their native language.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I've heard that too.
That just gets me even more excited about this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... If the original songs are in English, does that mean their shows are also all in English...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd imagine so.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh oh... I can pick out words and simple phrases fine, but what if I lose track of what's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They likely won't deviate too much from the movie's story, so I'm sure you'll be able to follow along.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, I'm more worried about interacting with people at the airport.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, customs. They'll probably ask us about why we're there and how long we'll be staying.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I've seen that on TV before!
“What's the purpose of your trip?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. They'll want to know if we're there for business or pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I remember hearing about that in class one time too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What else do you think they'll ask us, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, they'll need to know who we are, so we'll have to tell them our name and such.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, a self-introduction! I have one all lined up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahem... My name is Tsukasa Tenma, superstar!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna do that too☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hello! I'm Emu Otori!
“Emu” means “smile”!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, the meaning of your first name!
That's a nice touch!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Nene, let's hear yours!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?! U-Uh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I... I'm Nene Kusanagi...
I've come to America...
For the first time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: See, you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Are you sure? Is that really gonna be enough to get past customs?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. We're still minors, so I'm sure they'll let us through as long as we keep smiling.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And if anything does go wrong, we can always use Robo-Nene's translator function.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You know she can't come with us, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course she's staying behind.
There's no way anyone's going to let her on an airplane.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nooo! Robo-Nene has to stay?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I installed that translator just for this purpose! How could you, Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, I'm not the one you should be complaining to!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's Keisuke and Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Our ride's here. It's time to go!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, I can control her remotely and have her flown over a different way!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No way!
Not necessary!
Airport

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Do you have everything, Tsukasa?
You won't be able to run back for anything you leave here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah! You think that Tsukasa Tenma will make the same mistake twice?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yup. Pretty sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Guh! N-No matter!
I quintuple-checked before I left the hotel this morning!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that might be a bit much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose he's taking a “better safe than sorry” approach...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
They said we can go look around at the gifts since we still have time until we have to board!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, splendid!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we got a lot at the park, but I've also been meaning to see what the airport has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! Let's go take a look♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow, all these snacks...
And other daily essentials...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You don't see some of these brands back home, so I'm sure they'll make for wonderful souvenirs.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
That may be a good place to start looking for Saki's gift...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Guys, look!
I found a weird mask!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep! Wh-Where did you find that?! And why does that bear look so real?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I believe that's from a horror film. It's so strong that it can literally fold people into...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop right there! People aren't meant to be foldable objects!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu... You probably shouldn't give anyone that unless they actually like this kind of stuff, alright?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Welcome to America...
The land of the free and home of these sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's become a cult classic, so it is popular among certain crowds. I actually recommend seeing the original movie.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose it would need a bit of a following to be turned into a series... Alright, I'll try watching it if I get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, also...!
We should get Miku and the others something.
<What?! You're getting us gifts?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? My phone just flashed...
That means...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wah! Miku?! MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hi there! We decided to pop in and see you guys say your final farewells to the U.S.♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, perfect timing.
We were just wondering what to get all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us know if you see anything you like!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it'll be much easier now since you're actually here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yay! Thanks♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Okay, that covers Mom and Dad...
Also...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hehe. I even got something for Hoshino and her friends. I think I'll give this to her the next time we practice singing together.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <Neneee♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<There we go...
Thank you for letting us borrow your phone! Are you all done finding gifts for everyone?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now... I want to go home and do more shows.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh? Feeling a little homesick?
You haven't actually been gone that long...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But visiting Mr. Riley's park like this really taught me a lot...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to get home as soon as possible so that we can start trying out some of the things we felt and saw...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<That's great, Nene♪
You love of shows really knows no bounds!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I know so. The look you have right now paints a beautiful picture!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I noticed this while you guys were at the park, but you seem genuinely excited about “what's up ahead”!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: About “what's up ahead”...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. You might be right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, are you all done getting stuff for everyone?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should head over to the gate soon!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Alright, let's go home!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It might be a long while until we figure out how to put on world-class shows like what we saw at the park...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But for now, I want to get back to the Wonder Stage as soon as we can so we can start doing shows again!)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was worried about how practicing without Tsukasa would go, but things are going a lot smoother than I expected thanks to KAITO and Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since not having any understudies would make it just that much harder to time our lines and make them sound real.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup♪
And we just have to wait for Tsukasa to come back...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, I kept wondering what he's been doing this whole time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seemed like he had a bit of a realization the last time he was here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! He was trying really hard and nodding his head a lot!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on what KAITO and Miku said, I'm sure he's on the right track.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess we should trust him a little here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but Tsukasa's probably thinking lots and lots and lots about Thorpe right now, huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, probably...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What if he's whistling like a kettle?
Or what if he's getting really hungry?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm sure he's getting enough to eat.
I mean, he's the kind of person who actually says, “You can't fight on an empty stomach.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I really hope you're right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But can't we just check up on him a teeny bit?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you that worried about him?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, since we can't practice with him.
We go to different schools too, so it's like I haven't seen him in forever now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, point taken. It might be good for us to get an update on his progress soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. The three of us can take a quick look while making sure not to interfere.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!
After school the next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Knock knock. Nene, are you there?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. I'm here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can't you just let yourself in since you're here pretty much all the time now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just trying to be polite.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But! I'm also trying to be sneaky by talking softly so Tsukasa doesn't find out that I'm here☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, you two.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa seems to be on the rooftop.
Shall we go take a look?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?! Emu, wait!
What happened to being sneaky?!
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Alright, where's Tsukasa...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, there he is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Wait, look at all those books!
Is he reading them right now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah...
Those all seem to be “A Pianist Named Thorpe”...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-All of them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... In this book, the way he shouts, “I don't care about your party!” during the scene with the squirrels makes it sound like he's frustrated with the way he played...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this translation goes further with Thorpe being more aware of the contest closing in on him. That means the star scene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's what he's doing... He wants to get inside Thorpe's head by seeing how all these people translated his story.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It looks like he's still trying to work things out, but he also seems to be making progress. I'm sure he'll be fine without us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm really glad.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene, Rui...
He'll figure out how to play Thorpe, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm sure he will.
There's no way he's ever gonna give up by saying, “I can't do it!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, let's leave him be and head off to practice before he finds out we're here.

rows.Speaker: Nene & Emu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We can't do this show without you since you're our lead, so please figure this out soon...)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what would happen at first, but I'm glad our show as ambassadors went as well as it did.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Same. You especially deserve some special recognition, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you! Learning how to play Thorpe was no small feat, but I believe I was able to act to the best of my current abilities thanks to all of your support.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was also wonderful to hear the applause we received along with seeing the audience smile the way they did!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Saki and the others said they had a lot of fun watching too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope this means Phoenix Wonderland's gonna keep getting more visitors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I need to thank all of you for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What did we do?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, don't you remember? The three of you came up to the rooftop to check up on me while I was taking a closer look at Thorpe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?! But we were so sneaky!
How did you find out?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Actually, I had no idea.
Toya was the one who told me after the show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. Aoyagi was still in the classroom when the three of us met up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But I have to think he had a good idea as to what we were up to since he waited to say anything until the show was over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think so too! Isn't he so very thoughtful?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why are you the one bragging...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because Toya's like a little brother to me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem...
Anyway.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I asked a lot of all of you since I saw this show as an opportunity to grow as an actor, expand our show repertoire and take our performances to the next level...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I apologize for causing such a fuss.
And I'd like to thank you all for believing in me until the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
You said you'd figure it out, so we knew you would.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And we're all in this together, so we kinda had to believe in you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?!
Did Nene really just say that...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? You got a problem with that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, not at all!
I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
However...
Yes, that must be it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see now that I didn't just grow as an actor with this show. I also managed to get my friends to go from believing in me to respecting me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Respecting you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, not all at once.
I already know.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is what I must've been feeling lately. You were in awe and gazing at me with just that much respect!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What's he talking about...?
Gazing at him with respect? Seriously?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That seems to be his interpretation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, this time around...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By growing as an actor, our shows will evolve while also being able to try our hand at more genres.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So please! Give me a chance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Stop!
That's just you being you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Think more about how Thorpe would actually react.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Let's try that again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry for the delay...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I apologize for taking so long...
I'm sure I had you all worried.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I finally figured out what I have in common with Thorpe and know how to get into character now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Despite having never studied with another troupe or at a drama school, Tsukasa has his basics nailed down.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Above all else, he took a hard look at himself and Thorpe after realizing that they were complete opposites of each other.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And that's not easy to do. You have to really want to become a good actor to go that far.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (In that sense... Tsukasa's pretty incredible and always finds a way to impress us.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Alright, maybe I should actually tell him that for once...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Hehehe...
Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Listen up, all of you!
Revel in the glory of your great troupe leader!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't you all take this opportunity to start calling me “Leader” or “Star”?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Nevermind...
This definitely isn't the right time to compliment him.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More importantly, shouldn't we discuss what we'll be doing for our next regular show...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! What should we do next♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well...
Oh, I know. What about a story where Tsukasa split in half?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? I have no idea what you're actually talking about, but it sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that does sound fun... Not!
Rui, what do you mean by splitting me in half?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't plan on actually splitting you in half, so you'll be fine. It's just an idea for an effect...
Coast

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I could only put some simple dishes together, but they turned out surprisingly well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that may be because we went out to gather all those ingredients ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. We got to become real-life villagers!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, from our other ambassadorial performance. Hehe. Yeah, I guess so.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Hey, all of you.
If you don't have anything else to do, start getting ready for bed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Are you going somewhere, Shosuke?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We're running out of firewood, so I'll be out gathering some.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'll...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Use the remaining wood to keep the fire going.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, there he goes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is he sure about us not helping?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
As much as we'd like to...
I have a feeling that Shosuke doesn't want us venturing into the jungle again, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's understandable, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sure he won't have to go very far.
I mean, we have a fire set up, but that doesn't necessarily guarantee our own safety.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, he's likely going somewhere he can get back quickly in case something happens here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, there's something in the bushes over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But Shosuke went off in the other direction...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, what if it's the monkeys!
Let's go take a quick peek!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What if it's not?!
It might be dangerous, so I really don't think you should get too close...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I knew it! It's the monkeys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Honestly...
First, they steal our bananas, and now this. They must enjoy keeping us on our toes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the same time, what could they be doing here at a time like this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In general, monkeys start their day at dawn. I thought they'd be asleep now too since they usually go to sleep very early.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Do you think our campfire was keeping them up...?

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook♪ Ook♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Is it me or does it look like they're kinda having fun?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It could be as simple as them having taken an interest in us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: An interest in us...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. This island's uninhabited, so humans are probably a rare or new sight to them. As such, they may be curious to learn more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A new sight, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's actually really interesting.
When I realized that we were on a desert island, I couldn't help but be scared of the unknown or what was out there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, we were stranded and in a situation where our safety wasn't guaranteed. I feel it's only natural for someone to be fearful or anxious.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook ook... Ook!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? The monkeys are making funny faces for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna play! Let's see who can make the funniest face! Ook ook... Ook!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. This is so silly...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's also kinda nice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Nene, would you like to join them?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No way.
That's not what I meant by what I just said...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was talking about how it'd be nice if I could also learn how to “enjoy the unknown” or “learn more about the unknown”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was so afraid and convinced that I wouldn't be able to camp out or handle having to survive like this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I have a feeling that Ms. Kazamatsuri would've looked for a silver lining like Emu and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She would've tried doing something new and made some interesting discoveries...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That means I need to have more courage if I really want to make my dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's what you think, I believe you have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Remember what MEIKO said?
You've become someone who can face their fears.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <The moment before you go on stage is always a little scary because you're worried about how things will go and how the audience will react, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I've seen you overcome that countless times, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You think I can become someone who can face their fears like MEIKO said...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you believe that's what you need to become to make your dream come true, then I think you can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He's right, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Whoa! E-Emu?!
What happened to playing with the monkeys and seeing who could make the funniest faces?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
I did and I won!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, the monkeys started cracking up and applauding because of all the incredible faces she was making. They seemed very satisfied and left soon after.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: More importantly, Nene, I really don't believe you're as big a scaredy cat as you think you are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right, Rui, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, if you all think so, then I'll believe it too.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I found some wood that we can use for the fire.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Shosuke, welcome back!
Wanna see me make some funny faces?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Huh? Funny faces?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Emu, you can't just dump that on him without explaining what happened first.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Nene, you seem kinda anxious.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Today's the day our phones are supposed to be returned to us after being repaired, so I'm sure she's wondering if her data was safe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hey, I don't need a play-by-play of what I'm feeling right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I understand how you feel, Nene, especially since that strange song called Untitled is on our phones.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, KAITO said that as long as our feelings persist, Untitled will reappear even if we end up getting new phones.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means there's no need to worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, there is!
Besides Untitled, I had other songs, game data and stuff from messaging apps on there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, just not having my phone with me has been nerve-wracking.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, it was somewhat inconvenient...
But it's only been a few days since we sent them out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, you can just redownload everything you need.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know, but my phone was also my alarm... It also let me play games, listen to music or watch some videos if I had some time to spare...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The point is, I can't imagine living life without it. I haven't had it in my hands for several days now, so of course I'm getting antsy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
However, Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You speak of your phone as if it's some sort of music-playing-gaming device, while its original purpose is to be used as a means of communicating with others.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Guh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that seems to have hit her pretty hard.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hey, I still use it to talk to other people!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino in particular since I've been using it lately to set up practices with her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's actually what I'm worried about the most. I really don't remember the last time I backed everything up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If the data on my phone's gone...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even after finally becoming friends with Hoshino and the others and swapping contact info with them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? You can still see them if you really want to, no? I'm sure they'll understand if you tell her what happened.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I can always ask Saki about Ichika if need be.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I was finally able to actually talk to her because Rin was there to encourage me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. We went over to Miya Girls together to wait by the gate.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! We were also there supporting you in secret!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I remember being fairly frustrated over you being so slow and deliberate about asking her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, gimme a break...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hang on. Didn't you also swap contact info with Minori and Kohane? What did you do that time?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Hanasato and the others made that suggestion...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I finally made some friends who I can discuss music with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What if their contact info's all gone now...?! What do I do then...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I might not be able to practice singing with Hoshino and the others anymore...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like I said, I can always ask Saki... No, wait...! All you'd have to do is ask for their information again!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Never a quiet moment with all of you, huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Shosuke!
Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Um...!
About our phones...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Ah, they've been repaired and returned on schedule. I was also told that they were able to recover most of your data. So, here you are...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
Oh wow! The screen actually turned on...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Alright, the rest of you, here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I had the most talented technicians in our corporate group take a look at them so they should be fine, but you'll need to check to see if everything's still there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My phone appears to be okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, mine too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That also goes for Untitled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. My phone's happy and healthy too! What about you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm still checking...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(My game data's all there.
My music and photos too!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That just leaves my messaging apps...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, here we go!
My friend list and messages are all still intact!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad for you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm glad too...!
I was worried sick about losing all these friends...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Again, aren't you blowing this all a bit out of proportion?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I'm not.
Also, I need to make sure to back everything up.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Anyway, everything appears to be in order, so I'll be going now. I still have some work to do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks for delivering our phones to us, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right! Thank you so very much!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You're welcome. Now, I really need to get going.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we know that our phones are okay, let's head over for a long overdue visit!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It'll be great to let Miku and everyone know that we're back since we lost contact with them for a while!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My phone...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm so glad it's back in my hands just the way it was...!)
Two weeks until Nene's birthday
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's good, Hoshino.
Just keep using your diaphragm.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (When we first started practicing together, she kept tensing up and had some trouble keeping her throat open...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But now, she's able to give a song a boost of energy without tensing up like it's second nature...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nice work, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks. You too, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know some time's passed since our last one, but I had a lot of fun practicing with you today. I really appreciate you making the time for me like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was reminded of what I need to work on, and now I know what to look out for.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you too, Hoshino. I know you're busy practicing for your shows, so I'm glad you asked me to do this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, so... Hoshino...
Wanna try seeing when we can do this next...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. Let me just check my phone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi, that reminds me. This has nothing to do with practice, but would you mind me asking if you're free the week after next?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? The week after next?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Otori told me that the 20th is your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... I was wondering if you'd like to celebrate by going somewhere and getting something to eat with me, Otori, Minori and Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but I'm guessing you've already made plans for the day of. Would the day before possibly work?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, right...
Emu, the others and I are supposed to go to this party at the home of these people who've been supporting our shows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But the day before should work...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The week after next... That's about when we're supposed to start discussing the script for our next show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We won't actually be performing then, so I'll just have to ask Tsukasa and the others if it's okay for me to take some time off.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you, Kusanagi!
I'll be sure to let Minori and Kohane know!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Going out for food with Hoshino and everyone... Hehe. I can't wait.)
The day before Nene's birthday
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... What should I wear...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe something kinda nice since we're all going out to get something to eat together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh... I regret not discussing this with Emu when I asked if we could take some time off.
Two weeks earlier
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You'd like to go out for a meal with Ichika and the others the day before your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I don't see why not.
That's likely going to be when Rui and I will be putting the final touches on the script.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. You and Emu should be free to go then.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You mean it...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It's your special... The day before your special day, so you should go have fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! We're getting something to eat together! Hehe. It's gonna be so much fun, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hehe. Right in-between our previous show and the next one too. We couldn't have asked for better timing.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, no... I need to decide what to wear...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, this is way too dull...
This one's... Also dull...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh... Why do all my clothes look so similar? Lemme see... Next, I'll try...
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
This is the cafe where I work!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! It looks so trendy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it does. I'm not sure I would've been able to go in by myself. I'd be too afraid of sticking out like a sore, outmoded thumb...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I think I can empathize...
I get told a lot that my normal clothes are kind of dull.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is that true? If you like wearing what you wear, then I really don't think you should be bothered by what others say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Azusawa...
That was kinda really cool.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Until pretty recently, I was convinced that I had to wear whatever was “cool” or “in”. But then I made the realization that I should just wear what I think suits me best.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What suits you best, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone, here are your seats!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay♪ Oh, that reminds me.
Saki works here too, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, she does. She was really regretting not putting in for a shift today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She also said, “Thank you for always looking after my big brother, and please let me know if he ever causes you any trouble!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Trouble...? I mean, he can be a handful sometimes, but he's nothing compared to Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's always there for us when we need him, but I don't want to say that to him directly because he'll get too excited for his own good...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
I'll be sure to tell Saki that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do you all know what you want to get?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The parfait looks so big and yummy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It does. I didn't realize just how big it was. I'm not sure I can finish it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not to worry! It's sweet but in a really refined way, so it's really good! It'll be gone before you know it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, I think I can handle that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! Now, for inviting us out to have this meal... I mean, parfaits... Ichika, would you mind giving us a little speech?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... I invited all of you here today to celebrate Kusanagi's birthday, which is actually tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know some of us became friends just recently, but I hope we get to know each other better moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, I believe it's about time we fulfilled today's primary objective.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Kohane & Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Um... Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... Let's eat?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
Nene's birthday
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everything's just about set with our party area! So, right this way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh wow! It's like a standing buffet party!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
You celebrated your birthday with some of your friends yesterday, right? How was it? Did you have fun?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course. It was a fun celebration, and we got to talk about our favorite kinds of music, clothes and all sorts of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we'll have to do our best to make sure you have just as much if not more fun today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, I'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Co.
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's jump right into today's main event♪ Our inaugural hidden talents shooow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A hidden talents show?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we all thought very hard about what to do and practiced quite a bit just for this day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? Then, I'm looking forward to seeing what happens.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And leading things off for us will be... Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Present!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay... In my hand, I have a perfectly ordinary party popper! However, in the blink of an eye...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Voila! It can turn into a giant party popper!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She pulled it out from under the table...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I understand why you decided to make this a standing buffet party.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Now, it's time to pop this giant popper!
Who wants to help♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, us! Nene, let's pop it together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Three, two, one and pull, okay?
Ready? Three... Two... One!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What was that?! It just shot something into the air...! Wait... Are those the plushies?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! They even have parachutes!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A & B
rows.Line: Happy birthday, dear Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A & B
rows.Line: Happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow...
Hehe. Thank you for that adorable song, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A & B
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay! That concludes the surprise birthday song by Miku and the plushies with a special thanks to Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Rui, you helped?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, but only for technical support.
I modified the big popper so that the plushies could safely be launched from it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! I had no idea that you were also helping them with this show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Also?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew it. Your reaction to them unveiling their show felt pretty forced. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! I have no idea what you're talking about...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Next, for our act, we have a strange box that causes the expression on your face to change for some reason!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For this demonstration, we'll need a volunteer from the audience!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A-Ah, it changes your facial expressions?! That's very interesting! I'd like to assist if possible!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Now I get it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't write this off like it's no big deal! Yes, this box appears homemade, but it really is a fascinating contraption!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Alright, I understand.
Mind getting started for us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thank you for your aid, Tsukasa!
Now, we'll be taking this box on and off your head!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Watch as his facial expressions change over and over! Ready, start♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! What's this?!
My face!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Changing on its own!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Hehe...
Haha!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! Tsukasa, your face looks so funny!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's simple but extremely effective.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can't help but also want to make some funny faces watching them do this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, me too! Nene, check it out!
My eyes are whirling round and round!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Haha!
Your face! You look so ridiculous!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
T-Tsukasa, I give.
My sides hurt because I've been laughing so hard!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense! I may not be able to make as many funny faces as I can strike cool poses, but we're just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, really?!
We wanna see more!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As you wish!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, what happened to the box being the one that made you do this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Geez, everybody with their dumb gags...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still... This is pretty fun...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I guess I just really love spending time with them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Of course I do.
We're able to have serious discussions with each other about all our hopes and dreams.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And I know that we might eventually have to go our separate ways to pursue those dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, for now...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay! Next, we'll be presenting our hidden talents♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Cool! MEIKO and Luka are doing something together! What do think they're gonna do, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. KAITO seems anxious, so it could be something pretty spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to make the absolute most of the time I have with them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kusanagi!
I feel like I've come a long way since we started practicing together. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's okay with you, I'd like it if we could keep having these practices together... And I'm really looking forward to our next one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Nene!
I'm really glad you liked our cafe and parfait so much! Hehe. Also, we should practice singing again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really love the shows your troupe does, Kusanagi, so I promise to keep visiting and keep seeing more! And happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Once again, Nene, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're the vital songstress of Wonderlands×Showtime, so you should keep singing with confidence moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, he's right♪ Because your voice is so pretty, Nene! I could listen to you sing forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As your friend and neighbor, and on behalf of Robo-Nene, I'm looking forward to seeing what the future has in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So many kind words from everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I can't help but blush a little.
I mean, a high schooler like me getting such a huge celebration.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At the same time, I doubt I'm ever going to forget the party I had with everyone today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was so much fun...!
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Well, I'm here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But since we don't have practice today, I think I'll take this opportunity to play some video games to my heart's content.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... Puyo Puyo was over here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Hey, you're one of the Wonderhoy Button Mashers!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, hello...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Thank you for stopping by.
Which game are you thinking about playing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, Puyo Puyo...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Did you make sure to bring your special champion's card? It'll give you access to every game, so please enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (W-Wow... I really get to play for free...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, lemme look at the play modes...
Pretty sure “Puzzle League” is the one for ranked matches.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah, they're rated matches.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As for my player name... I'll just go with “pomelo” as usual. Now, for my first match...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, they made another mistake...
I guess it is my first match. It probably wasn't going to make me play against someone strong.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Alright, let's finish this!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I won...!
I'm glad I put in the effort to work on my building skills.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There doesn't seem to be anyone else here, so I might just keep playing and see how many wins I can stack up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, they're building from the bottom left... They seem to know what they're doing. I may be in for a tough battle...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're fast, but I've also improved a lot. I should be able to keep up.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just need to keep building chains while popping things along the way, and send over some Garbage Puyos to keep my opponent from completing their chains!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Th-They're dealing with everything really well... They're definitely good... But!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My build's complete! Now I just need to...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I did it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Impressive. You were able to outbuild and defeat your opponent despite them being at a higher level.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A-Aoyagi...?!
When did you...? Wait, were you watching me play just now?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I also stopped by to play some Puyo Puyo and saw you playing, so I decided to observe your match.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh no! He probably heard me yell, “Yes!” and “My build's complete!” just now... No, he definitely did!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In any case, you won in a nice fashion. Have you been practicing since that gaming tournament?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?! Uh, yeah...
I did a little research on how I should be building and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Just a little...?
And you were able to do this well? That's pretty incredible.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, I was only able to do what I did probably because my rating's still low. My opponent did make some mistakes, but they were still really good.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'm guessing people of your caliber play at way faster speeds than this, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll also become used to playing faster as you gain more experience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More experience, huh? I suppose even for first-person shooters you have to make adjustments based on how a game's going or your opponent's playstyle.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I have to agree with you about gaining more experience since playing against real people is the best way to get better at PvP games.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, since we're on the subject, how about we play a match...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still have a long way to go as a player, but I should be able to teach you some basic building patterns and such.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're going to teach me? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course. I mean, I've had the pleasure of meeting a strong rival, so it'd be nice if we could push each other to become better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And you just said so yourself Kusanagi. The best way to get better at PvP games is to play against real people, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I did...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But learning to play a game from someone... It's like...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-It's like we're really friends...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um... O-Okay...
I think I'll take you up on your offer...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excellent. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure. Thank you as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I initially wanted to enter that tournament to win the tickets for that show...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But to think that I'd end up meeting a new gamer buddy...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I might try entering another tournament...)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Boo.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Rui?!
Don't scare me like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. My apologies.
I thought I should let you know that breaktime's almost over.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay... You could've just said so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, you seemed very focused on your phone just now. Mind if I ask what you were looking at?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Remember the show we're all gonna see together? The one we get to see because we received tickets for it as a prize for winning that gaming tournament.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was just going through the game that it's based on and reading through its story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You said that it's an adaptation of a video game. Would it be possible for you to give me a synopsis?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, it's supposed to take place in modern Europe and it's basically an RPG with some mystery elements sprinkled in...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The protagonist is someone who's always dreamed since they were little about venturing into this castle-like structure, but they've never actually seen it before...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And one day, the castle from the protagonist's dreams appears before them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... And?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As a result, all these things that were happening only in their dreams begin to occur in real life.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only that, this boy that the protagonist had only ever talked to in their dreams appears in the city where they live!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The boy from their dreams appears where they live?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right! The protagonist and this boy decide to head towards the castle from the protagonist's dreams, but there's also a big secret surrounding him...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A... A big secret?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Emu?! Tsukasa?! When did you two...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We came to let you know that it's about time to get back to practicing. However, you seemed to be telling an interesting story, so we decided to stop and listen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You could've given me a bit of a heads-up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's just one surprise after another today...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We would have, but you were giving such a passion-filled presentation that it didn't feel right to interrupt.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
Your eyes were sparkling as you talked just now, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! It reminded me of the time you told us about Ms. Kazamatsuri!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You did say that you've been a fan of this title for quite some time, so it must be a very intriguing story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
What's the protagonist's big secret? Can you tell us?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's... No, I can't!
I was about to let it slip, but I won't say because it'll be a huge spoiler.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sure the show will paint a good picture, so I think it's best to find out how things unfold then.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! I'll wait patiently while looking forward to seeing what happens!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I was thinking about reading up on it a little... At the same time, I wouldn't want to ruin the surprise...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is a coin toss, but I'll try seeing it without any knowledge of what's going to happen!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As for me, I'm interested in how they went about adapting the game's story into a script for the stage, so I'll likely perform a bit of research beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing how the ideas I come up with compare to what they actually do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, why don't I lend you the game?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As a whole, it's a trilogy, but this show only seems to cover the first game, so you should have enough time to play through it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, hang on. It might actually be better to play the remastered version. They fixed a few kinks in the story and made it easier to follow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. In that case, I'll follow your recommendation and try playing that version of the game.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, then I'll lend you that one.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I put a ton of hours into it and still remember how to get through the story, all the battle gimmicks and stuff, so let me know if you ever need any help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And in the event that I'm too slow and can't quite finish the story, I can always ask you to do a commentated speed run for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... This game's also piqued my interest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would it be possible to play just partway without revealing any spoilers?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not really if you stop somewhere in the middle.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like a riddle wrapped in a mystery. You'll find the answer to a question and end up being faced with even more questions.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember getting this game and staying up really late because I was so eager to see what happened next.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Then, I'll just have to wait until the day of.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. And we get to see this show together! I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me neither.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Despite this game being really good, I didn't really know anybody my age who knew much about it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But now, I'm gonna get a chance to talk with everyone about it.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, why can't it be the day of the show already?)
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... “How to preserve lemons in honey”...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I got some results.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “All you need are lemons and honey. It's very simple, and a great way to both recover and boost your immune system!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? All I need are lemons and honey...? I shouldn't have any trouble making this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'll need a lidded jar to keep them in... Okay, I can grab one while I buy the other stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's a really simple recipe, so it should turn out pretty well... Right?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And I hope we get to talk more next time.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we take a break here?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Everyone, let's all take a quick break!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Nene, let's sit over there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure... Oof.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Practice has been pretty hard...
But...)

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Sorry, can I ask you a question about the scene we just did?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, do you mean the part where we speak at the same time?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Yeah! We didn't really sync right because I was having trouble with the timing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You were? I mean, it's a conversation between a human and an android. I feel like it's more realistic if there were some hiccups along the way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Discussing in detail about what you see and notice is always really fun. You learn so much from it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wish I could do the same when it came to singing...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I should've done more to try to talk to them about it when we went to that diner...)

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Emu, Nene, great work out there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eep...!
Y-You too...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right back at you!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
How does some herbal tea sound?
Would you two like some?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! It smells like a bouquet of flowers!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does...
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
This tea's actually really great for your throat.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: I try to drink some before and during practices. It makes such a huge difference too. My voice feels completely different depending on whether I do or don't drink it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's really interesting.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hey, you're drinking that tea you always bring. Did you bring some for the rest of us?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, I want some too!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line: Same!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Okay, okay. I'll make some for all of you. Just gimme one sec.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I should thank her...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, this herbal tea's so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and she said it's good for your throat...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really want to talk with everybody from ArcLand about this herbal tea, singing and how to rest and recover after practice.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I had a few chances to talk to them after that, but we usually only ever discussed practice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I had so many chances to ask them about other stuff too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But next time's my chance...!
I mean, that's why I'm making these honeyed lemons!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Okay, this seems like a good place to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is my chance to bring them out, but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: I made some more herbal tea today. Who wants some?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
My chance to share what I made with everyone is gonna slip away...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wah! Wh-What is it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm not really sure what you want to do, but you can do it!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right! Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I know I'm gonna regret it later if I don't act now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, would you also like some tea?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, please.
Also, um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you all like to have some of these...?!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Hm? What do you have for us?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
Oh wow! Honeyed lemons!
I really love these!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, so...
You were nice enough to share your tea with us, so I wanted to give something back that's also good for your throat...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also... I-I'd like to ask you guys more about singing and recovering after practice...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
Of course.
We've actually been wondering what you guys' routines were, Nene.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line: Yeah, we all probably take care of ourselves differently, so it's always great to hear from different people!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You did it, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah... Thanks, Emu.
You gave me the push I needed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was just wondering what you wanted to do, Nene. That's all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you gave me the courage to speak up. So, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're super welcome♪
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Hmph... You're a machine. Speak when you are spoken to.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Understood. Please excuse my insolence.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I possess the power to shut you down at will. Don't ever forget that.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I suppose there's no way for you to understand the implications of what I just said.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “To be shut down...is to die...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “You seem like a pain, robot...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, stop there.
Nene, let's try that scene again with Asahi in Tsukasa's place.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a short break.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Asahi and Tsukasa interpret that scene so differently from one another.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Compared to Asahi, the tone of the voice for Tsukasa's version of Bartlett seems kinda random sometimes.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I want to say that it has to do with how he believes Bartlett is trying to process everything he's being told...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But they're like polar opposites when it comes to that discussion about death.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa seems to hesitate a little, like he's not sure if what he's saying is the right answer.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (While Asahi says that line like it's purely a matter of fact. No ifs, ands or buts.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He says, “Please excuse my insolence,” with some bit of force, which makes how nonchalantly he delivers the next part about dying all the more surreal...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's hard to believe how they can diverge so much on just one role...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, that was great!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're doing such a good job of playing a really scary drill sergeant! I got goosebumps all over!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? You don't seem all that happy? What's wrong? Oh, are you getting hungry?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, I'm not you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But you're not wrong...
I was wondering just now if I doing a good enough job as I interact with Tsukasa and Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They both tried playing Bartlett, but ended up playing him so differently...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I felt that too.
The same thing happened when they played Alfred.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So it wasn't just me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! I totally get it.
They play Alfred really differently, but it's still Alfred.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right.
And I need to do my best to act alongside them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, you seem concerned. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui, Asahi.
There's something I want to ask you... Wait, where's Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: He's talking to my castmates about the next scene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
For now, I'll ask you two...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... You're worried that you could be doing a better job of interacting with Tsukasa and Asahi as they play Bartlett...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Really? I thought you were doing just fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you believe you could be doing better... Right, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I think so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Oh! I wanna learn how to interact with them better too! Lots better!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Thank you, Emu.
In that case, well...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: This may not sound all that profound, but doesn't that have to do with really seeing how the person opposite to you is acting?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really seeing how they're acting...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought I did...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that you've both established a good foundation. However, there does appear to be one difficult bit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you concur, Asahi?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes. For example, the scene we just practiced...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Remember how you spoke with your back turned to Bartlett, Nene? You were treating him like someone who deserves that little respect, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
I wasn't looking at Tsukasa's face that time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's doing a good job of showing how Sergeant Willis feels about Bartlett, so I'm not sure we can do much to change that part.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I noticed something when Tsukasa and I played that scene just now. When I say, “Please excuse my insolence,” I never looked towards Nene.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But when Tsukasa played Bartlett, he tried to make eye contact with you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe that is Tsukasa's way of presenting a small aspect of Bartlett's humanity.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I liked what he did there too. It felt like he was making a real effort to make a human connection.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really?
I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, there are times when I can't tell what other people are doing because I have my back turned to them...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's perfectly fine. “Seeing” how someone is acting doesn't literally involve looking at them.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, when you're not sure, it's good to ask others who watch you practice about particular scenes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, now I understand...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We've been making an effort to dissect our performances up until now, but it's nice to be taking such a deep dive like this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm gonna try asking more people from now on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Asking is easy, and even though it's not like I did until now... Being more intentional about it is gonna make a huge difference moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, Asahi, thank you both for taking the time to answer my question.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Rui & Asahi
rows.Line: You're welcome.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're supposed to meet Emu and her sister somewhere around here, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... And it was so nice of her to offer to drive.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's nice to meet you all.
I'm Emu's big sister, Hinata.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You must be Tsukasa, Nene and Rui. I've been meaning to meet all of you for quite some time now.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You were just talking about doing shows in various different places, no? I'd like to help you with that, and I can drive if need be.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Out of all her siblings, Emu and her sister seemed the most related to one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, Emu's description of her being “soft and cuddly” fits perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I remember her saying that when she mentioned that she has siblings.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, everyone! What a wonderhoy evening♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Emu?
I thought you were coming by car with your sister.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, she's waiting at the light just over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, she asked me to ask you guys to move to a spot where she'll be able to park her car!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I see! We hadn't thought of that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, we should move.
Let's go, Robo-Nene, Lion Dance Robot.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't know that your sister had a driver's license.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. She actually just got it really recently.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke's been helping her practice by driving around in the garden!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The garden?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right... Emu's house is unbelievably huge, so I wouldn't be surprised if they had the space to do something like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If anything, I'm more surprised by how she's driving a car that's big enough to fit Robo-Nene, Lion Dance Robot and all of us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Actually, her car's a lot smaller and cuter.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today, she's driving Shosuke's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, did you hear that just now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hear what...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What in the world is this black, behemoth of a vehicle?! And how was it able to stop right in front of us just now?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hello, everyone! I apologize for making you wait in the cold like this!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's her...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Sis! Can you open up the back for us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This car looks expensive! Is it an import? I've only ever seen anything like this in Hollywood films...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Excellent. There should be plenty of room for both Robo-Nene and Lion Dance Robot.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How are you so calm?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because Emu mentioned Shosuke's name towards the end of her sentence.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He owns a cruiser, so it seems fair to believe that he also owns a few expensive cars.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Is something wrong? Come aboard. It's nice and warm inside.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, we also had the chef make a little something for us to eat along the way. Please have some whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I see. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I even had him look up some rest areas along the way that apparently serve delicious food.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nice work, Sis! You're the best♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Aren't I though? I had all of that information printed out and placed on your seats, so please have a look later.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I know you'll all be busy once you start actually doing your shows, but we should have plenty of time to make a few stops on the way over.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds nice.
Why don't we start flipping through these now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought this when we went to Emu's house that other time, but her family really does seem to think on an entirely different scale...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, not many people get to start the new year off like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And we're all together, which should make things fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Right. We get to welcome in the new year together.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last did that with anyone outside of my family.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem excited, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I kind of am.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Rui! I need help loading Robo-Nene! Can you lend me a hand?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I'll help too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Today's probably gonna be super hectic, but I'm really looking forward to seeing how it actually turns out.)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's almost time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I know you're busy with band practice and everything, so thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's my pleasure.
I mean, I always learn so much when we practice singing together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Also...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Hoshino.
Let's make this year a good one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Kusanagi!
And yes, I'm hoping that we can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I finally got a chance to tell you in person.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanted to talk to you at the beach, but we had to scramble to keep our show going.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki said that you guys performed in a few different places that day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. On top of a mountain, at a ski resort, the mall...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The audience even behaved and reacted pretty differently based on where we performed. That was actually kind of interesting to see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you guys changed your dance routine based on how the audience members who volunteered sang, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Improvising wasn't easy, but I thought it was a good experience.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's incredible... I mean, I sort of froze up when Tsukasa asked me to sing that time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not many would know what to do in that situation...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you made it really easy for us to dance since you put on such a good singing performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only that, more people began to gather after hearing you sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I think it's incredible that you were able to do that on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, really.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wh-What do I do...? I've pretty much said everything that I was hoping to...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Um... What else is there...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
