rows.Line: Um, Kusanagi... Can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? S-Sure, what's up?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you're interested, would you mind coming to see us perform again?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I got to see your band play a little during Shibuya Festa, but not at a live house yet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... Yes, I'd love to see one of your shows as long as it doesn't conflict with one of ours.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I really want to see you sing with your band at a live house, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Kusanagi!
I promise to let you know once we have a date for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm a little nervous about going to a live house...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't worry! I know they have a reputation for being kinda scary, but the place we play at is actually really nice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll have a good time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, I'll make seeing one of your shows one of my New Year's resolutions.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Great! We'll make sure to practice and be ready for you whenever.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, wanna start our first practice of the new year?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today's practice was more exhausting than usual for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it was also really good since we got so much done...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think we have Tsukasa to thank for that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“I do not know.
I am no swordsman, nor do I possess the strength to break stone.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “At the same time, how long has this feeling lingered within me...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “This inexplicable compulsion to protect the world. It feels as though it has been branded into my soul...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (After just a few days of attending that workshop, Tsukasa learned how to act in such a convincing manner...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, he sort of had to learn acting all on his own up to this point.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And yet, despite never being part of a theatre group or learning from experienced actors before, he's able to put on these incredible performances playing the lead role.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He improved so much after working with Asahi too. If he receives formal training on top of that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, there's still the possibility that the director running Tsukasa's workshop is just really good at what they do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A workshop, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It reminds me of how much fun I had with my theatre group when I was little. It's like I got to make a new discovery each time I went...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Then, I got to be the lead...and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I'm not scared of going on stage anymore. I have the others behind me.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But is that because I know they're performing alongside me...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What happens when I have to go on stage with people I don't know...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yikes... I'm already sort of afraid of meeting a bunch of new people all at once... I feel like I'd freeze up or something...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But it's not like I'm completely uninterested in attending one of those workshops.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe I should practice introducing myself a bit...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Something normal...
Nothing like the weird one Tsukasa did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My name is Nene Kusanagi. I'm looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I should probably say, “It's nice to meet you,” somewhere... Also, where I work and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My name is Nene Kusanagi. It's nice to meet you. I perform in shows at Phoenix Wonderland as a member of the cast.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Uh oh...
What do I say after that part...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... My hobbies, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I tried looking online for some good ways to introduce myself, but I don't think any of them will work for me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can probably talk about the shows I've seen and done just fine... But those workshops usually involve having discussions...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Plus, doing a show with a big group isn't just about acting. You have to talk and get to know each other...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Having to meet new people to do shows with them is probably the worst part of theatre for me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But Tsukasa's working really hard, so I should...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Found it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
The notebook I kept when I was still with my old theatre group was right where I left it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Most of what I wrote is pretty fundamental, but I might be able to learn something new by going back through it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll start by reviewing everything in here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's begin...!
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I've finished reviewing everything I learned when I was with my children's theatre group.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: From how to project my voice to maintaining a good posture... In hindsight, going back through this notebook was a really good idea.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like keeping the fundamentals in mind is going to help me hit even higher notes when I sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line:
“So can you if you truly believe.
Wherever you like, beyond your wildest dreams...”

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line: “And at the end, Neverland awaits!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Tsukasa's grown so much more...
There's no way this alone will help me catch up to him.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wish I could do more...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, everyone who performed alongside Tsukasa was really famous.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He said that they worked on their fundamentals before putting them into practice... I'd love to hear what his fellow attendees have to say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like what they keep in mind while acting, which techniques they use and the roles they've played in the past...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd love to talk to them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...
The next day
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why don't you just ask him...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? But...that feels like cheating.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's already taught us so much in the name of making the world of theatre a better place...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, we're not talking about what he learned here. We're talking about having him tell us what he discussed with his fellow attendees.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Having him reveal that to us...
It's like we're just benefitting from all his hard work, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, Tsukasa does have a talent for making friends quickly. Not only that, he often becomes the center of attention before we know it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Meanwhile, Nene, your shyness tends to prevent you from doing so unless you're given a golden opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You didn't have to say that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry, I suppose that was a bit mean.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Regardless, everyone has their strong and weak points. This isn't something that you can resolve overnight, so you really don't need something like that hanging over your head.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, if it's bothering you that much, you need only start working on fixing that part of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not saying that you're not making an effort to, Nene. I'm just saying that Tsukasa's good at interacting with others, so why not lean on him a little...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Honestly, it'd be a waste to let such a good learning opportunity go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since Tsukasa's going out of his way to show us what he was taught.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He's right. After each day of his workshop, he's been telling us all about what he learned and the discussions he had with everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I sorta do want him to tell me more about what he talked about with the other attendees...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for the advice, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
By the way, Tsukasa's usually in this classroom about now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? You want me to ask him now...? I mean... I'm not sure I'm ready to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Rui, Nene!
What brings you two here?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Morning...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-The thing is, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Would you mind telling us more about the other people who attended your workshop?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like how they practiced and what roles they played in the past... I-If you're allowed to tell us. You don't have to if you can't...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I was wondering what you were going to ask. Is that it?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! For future reference, I asked quite a lot about how they liked to get into character!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, there's the bell.
We'll have to pick this back up during lunch or at a later time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case...
Why don't we wait until Emu's also with us? I'm sure she'll want to hear all about what you heard.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good point. Then, we'll continue this discussion when we're at the Wonder Stage! I'll see you both later!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That worked out pretty well, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're welcome.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, the light's about to change...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Why don't we wait for the next one?
We still have plenty of time until we have to meet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Kanade Yoisaki...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, Honami invited her to make candles with us because she also seems to be having trouble deciding what to do for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh no... I'm really sorry. I should've asked you about this first.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, it's okay.
I mean, I'm a fellow student, so it's not my choice anyway.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, that name... It sounds so familiar...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Where have I heard it before...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, I remember now...! That time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you two already know each other?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... She helped us out the other day, but I only got to talk to her for a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see.
Talk about a small world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, also... Yoisaki's gonna join us when we go shopping for supplies, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. When we do, I'll be sure to reintroduce you two to each other.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yoisaki, huh...? I've technically already met her, but we didn't really speak, it barely counted...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope I can keep a conversation going with her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But Hoshino's friends with her, so she's gotta be a sensible person...unlike some people I know... I'll be fine, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi, the light turned green.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think I'm starting to get nervous again...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (B-But Hoshino's here, so I should be fine...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I got a message from Kanade yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she said that she's looking forward to meeting you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade's a really nice person, so I'm sure you two will get along just fine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's looking forward to meeting me...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was all worried about being able to keep a conversation going with her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this is my chance to get to know her.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As nervous as I am, I'm also starting to look forward to meeting her.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Did Hoshino notice how I was feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Is that why she said that?
Was she trying to help me relax...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thanks, Hoshino...)
The day after Valentine's Day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm running a little late. Homeroom went on for longer than expected.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They seem to be enjoying themselves. I wonder what's going on.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, there she is. Right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right on cue?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene! We've been waiting for you☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wah! Wh-Why are you hugging me all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We were actually just talking about the scented candles you gave us, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, did you guys already try them out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! The one you gave me smelled so nice! It made me feel all warm and fuzzy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then, I dreamt that I was walking through some woods☆ Hehe. When I woke up the next morning, I was already out of bed for some reason♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You tossed yourself out of bed...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you have a good nose, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The candle I gave you is supposed to give you the feeling of being out in the sun or in a forest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! I was right♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, then... Can you explain why my candle had such a refreshing fragrance to it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It smelled very much like oranges...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right. I used a sweet orange fragrance. It's supposed to help clear your head and feel refreshed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so it was oranges!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I tried lighting it before I went to bed and I seemed to sleep much better than usual!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? Then, I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, what was yours like?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mine? I believe it was some sort of musk...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Correct. I went for something a little more mature that felt subtle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mature and subtle...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Do you have something to say?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I understand what you mean, Tsukasa. I thought the hardest about which fragrances to choose for Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thing is... I had the idea to mix and match to create something more...chaotic?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that sounded really hard for a beginner like me, so I decided to go with something simpler.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for giving our gifts so much thought, Nene. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm just glad you all like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was my first time making these and I tried to choose fragrances that suited all of you, so I was actually really worried that you wouldn't like them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! But they turned out so well. I had no idea that you were also that worried, Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also...? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe... The truth is, I was also worried about how you guys would feel about what I made.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You were?
It certainly didn't seem like you were worried...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, if anything, you seemed rather confident...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's because I gave you guys the chocolates which turned out the best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Unfortunately... I made a lot of mistakes along the way...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I tried mixing chocolate pens to get the colors I wanted, but they kept becoming a shade too light or too dark...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even when I tried drawing you guys' faces with them, I'd sometimes grip you too tight and make your arms and heads fall off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, and Nene, your hair's really fluffy, so I made sure to use a separate mold for that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But when I tried to attach it too firmly, your head would fall off. And it wouldn't stay on if I didn't apply enough pressure, so you kept ending up with a chrome dome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That sounds like quite an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, Emu.
I really appreciate how much effort you put into our gifts.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I worked really hard because I wanted to see you guys smile☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. That makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I mean, it is Valentine's Day.
You're supposed to sort of put your heart and soul into your creations.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Say, Emu...
Can you show me how you made those chocolates sometime?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Of course☆
I wanna learn how to make scented candles♪ Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd be more than happy to teach you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I only decided to make something for Valentine's Day after Emu said that she was going to...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm really glad I did...)
Early morning
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Yawn* Morning, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello, Nene.
Thank you for meeting with me so early.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, it's okay since I was planning to practice on my own this morning...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what is it that you wanna talk about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, remember how we agreed to help Tsukasa figure out his character?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be honest, getting on the same level as Seiryuin as she is now will be incredibly difficult...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you still wish to go through with this regardless...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was totally blown away by Seiryuin's performance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa felt the same way... No, he's been practicing opposite her, so he must feel the skill gap even more clearly.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But he still refuses to give up...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what do you need me to do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's simple.
However, what I'm about to ask of you is likely not going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I built this Robo-Phoenix based on the bird robots I made for one of our shows. I'd like you to help me bring her to life.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Bring it to life...?
Wait, that thing's huge!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The birds for that show fit in the palm of your hand. This one's at least three times as big!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. She should make for a good practice partner in terms of chasing a phoenix around.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I made this one bigger and reinforced her quite a bit so that a person can physically grab onto her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And don't underestimate her.
After replacing the parts with more lightweight ones and optimizing her performance, she can do significantly more compared to her predecessors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've even programmed a new algorithm that should make it much harder to catch her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what do you need me to do exactly? You said you wanted me to help you bring it to life...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like for you to play the phoenix, Nene. I need to take some recordings for Robo-Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, me...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Simple, no?
But difficult at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Me...? Playing the phoenix...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I can't do what she did...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay, I'll give it a try...
I mean, I did promise to help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “How does what feel...?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is how I imagine the phoenix...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“I think nothing of it.
I have long since gotten used to all that...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm capturing how she really feels...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But is this gonna be good enough...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nicely done, Nene.
Robo-Phoenix should be ready to use during practice later today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, you're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've finished recording... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, she's moving on her own...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What have I done...?! I was trying to play back the recordings, but powered her on instead!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Nene.
Could you help me try to catch her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, she went that way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Got her!
No, she flew away...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Oh, done already...?
You sounded so confident about catching me just now.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, that line...)

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Too slow.
Honestly, where are you looking? Are you not going to catch me?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I sorta feel compelled to keep trying...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But it's not her...
All I'm hearing is a person talking.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As I currently am... I can't do what she can...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I should at least try to sound more like a phoenix by doing what I can to capture how a bird moves and behaves...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that reminds me! I can send her a signal to stop in case of emergencies! There we are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? How can you forget about something like...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No, wait... He wouldn't...
That means he powered her on to...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry, Rui.
Would you mind if we rerecorded everything?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not happy at all with my portrayal of her. What we have right now isn't going to help Tsukasa much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course I don't mind.
We can keep trying until you feel satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There's no one else here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Did I get here too early...?
As much as I want to get in some practice on my own, I won't be able to if the stage isn't open.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But after seeing that performance...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Yes...
You... You were always so mean, but also kind...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You were willing to become my very first friend...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I'm sorry, Phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I'm so sorry...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really hope the Phoenix Stage is open...)
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank goodness. It's open...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Good morning, Nene! You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: Morning! We're looking forward to another great practice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa! G-Good morning...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They've already started...
Oh, some of the others are over there...)

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Hey, can we go over that scene again? I feel like I'm really close to getting it right!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Yeah, you have been improving a lot.
But I'm not letting you steal the spotlight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, this is the Phoenix Stage...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Anyway, I should also get started...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We have our Rio now, so all that's left is to practice until the show opens.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll use that time to learn as much as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And then...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And then...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was really moved by Tsukasa and Seiryuin's performance during the audition...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why, I...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wanna reach where they are...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene!!! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...? E-Emu...?! Geez, you scared me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know that you'd already be here, Nene! Were you practicing on your own?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, um... Sort of...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The performance we saw during the audition was so good that I wanted to try doing more...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I don't even know where to begin...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I know☆ The audition was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Sakurako performed like it was the real thing! I was so moved that I started tearing up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Same...
Wait, Emu... You're tearing up now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Just thinking about it is making my eyes water...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I get what you mean.
Here, use my handkerchief.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's okay! I brought one today.
This one!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh, that looks like a piece of candy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh oh. I thought I put it in this pocket... How about this one? Huh? A biscuit?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no! Maybe it's this one!
What?! Chocolate...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Just use mine already.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In return, you can have this candy, biscuit and chocolate! I hope they can help cheer you up!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's like she knows somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, Emu. I feel better already.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Have you stretched already, Nene?
If not, wanna stretch together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: That should do it for our read-through. I want you all to use the remaining time to practice the scenes you appear in.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're really picking up the pace now that they've cast Rio.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to figure out this role soon since rehearsals will be starting.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I want to start by practicing for my first scene as the Cowardly Canary...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Uh... Where are the actors playing the scary forest animals...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The Cowardly Canary interacts with Rio too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But as I am now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No. I don't have time to think like that. I need to practice.)

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: There you are, Kusanagi! Could we practice the scene where our characters meet?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, they're playing the forest animals...)

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: Were you about to go ask Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I was just looking at him and thinking about how I should put in as much effort as he has. Um... I'd be happy to practice with you.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Great! The pleasure is all ours.
I welcome criticism, so please give me any and all feedback you have!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone from the Phoenix Stage is so motivated.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have so much to learn from them.)

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: I have to say, I'm blown away by Tenma's progress. Who would've thought he'd build his character to that extent in the few days leading up to the audition?

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Right! The future's way past bright for that guy. Who knows how much further he'll perfect the role before we open?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to keep up with him.)
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I haven't walked home alone like this in a while.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Rui said he had to discuss something with the director. I wonder if it's about the direction, or about his performance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And it looked like Emu was tracking down everyone she has a scene with to discuss with them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone's trying so hard to make our performance of “The Happy Phoenix” a success.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I want to do my part too...
But I'm still not satisfied with my performance.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm not good enough yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to work much harder.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I still haven't become the Cowardly Canary. I need to deepen my understanding of the role.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Would it help if I put myself through the same experience as my character, like Tsukasa did?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The canary is afraid of the forest and the animals there that might eat her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I could go somewhere that scares me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The canary's fear is for her own life, but I won't go that far... Even so, it could be a chance to imagine how she feels.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Anyway, right now I just need to do anything I can!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, once I get home I'll search for somewhere to go.
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...! G-Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Good morning, Kusanagi. You're here bright and early!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Morning, Kusanagi! Are you also here to get in some solo practice?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I am. Also, I was wondering...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Could I join you for stretches?

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Certainly, be our guest! By the way, how is practice going? We don't have any scenes together, but I'm curious to hear about your progress.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Yeah! So am I.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...! Also, could I ask later about how things are going with your scenes?

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Of course! Ask away!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you! I will.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Deploying the parachutes!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perfect. They deployed smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look Nene! Look at the parachutes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The parachutes?
Oh, there's something written on them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hap...py... Birth...day...?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: That's right♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you, plushies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe, this is amazing...
There's even a petal shower.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. We made the petals♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? It must've been a lot of work to make so many.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not at all. All of this effort is totally worth it to put a smile on your face.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you... I never would've expected you to prepare so much for me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's your birthday! There's no way we wouldn't have♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup yup♪ We love you so much, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Thank...you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You'll be celebrating with your friends tomorrow, right? Have lots of fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You will be there as well, won't you, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure will☆ Five of us are meeting up to go to the petting zoo and a cafe, and then we're finishing the day off at the arcade♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We'll be meeting up with some others at the arcade. So I guess that'll make seven of us in total.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh... To think I'd see the day the once shy and timid Nene would celebrate her birthday with others outside of her family...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're one to talk, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But even I'm a little surprised... I never thought I'd ever make this many friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Remember, Nene. Friends are forever. Make sure you treasure them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I know.
Nene's birthday
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! They're here!
Hey, over here♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi, Otori. Sorry, did we make you two wait long?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's okay. We just came too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Thank you for inviting me out today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, we should be the one's saying that. Let's have lots of fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Also...
Thank you for coming too, Mochizuki, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought it would be more fun if there were more people to celebrate with, so I hope you don't mind me joining.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori's at work, so I hope you don't mind me taking her place.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're more than welcome. Thank you so much for coming.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's a little early to be thanking us, don't you think? The fun has only just started.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ Let's have the most, super duper fun day ever☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well then, let's go!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Welcome to the Fluffball Petting Zoo! The next group may now head in!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! Look, Nene!
There's so many bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They're all so cute. Oh... We're allowed in this area to get close to them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We can even crouch down and put them on our laps. I hope they don't run away, though...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can use the food we got to get them to come over. Hey there, don't be shy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, they came. Hehe, they're eating the carrot like their life depends on it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, Kusanagi, why don't you two try?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. Here you go. Want a carrot?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have some too. They're really yummy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, they're coming!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Or not? They just went past us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and they're all gathering over there–

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Why are all of them coming over here?
I-I don't have any more carrots.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Whoa! P-Please don't nibble on my clothes!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hahaha! You're so popular, Honami♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Lucky you, Honami. Surrounded by all of those rabbits...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, maybe they think you smell nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't just watch! Help me!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Here's your Seasonal Fruit Feast Parfait!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! They really didn't hold back on the fruit!
Looks so yummy♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Oh, I should take a photo to remember the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we ask the staff when they bring “that” over.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“That” what?
I thought everyone's orders already arrived...

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting! Here is your surprise birthday cake!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Cake?
Whoa! There's even a sparkling candle too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's get a photo before it goes out. Excuse me, would you please take a photo of us?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hurray☆ Big smiles, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Here we go! Say, “Cheese!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Ahhh...
I'm so full.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too. I really wasn't expecting that surprise cake.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That was Minori's idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though she couldn't make it, she still wanted to do something special for your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That makes me so happy. I really didn't think I'd ever experience a surprise like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad you liked it. I'll let Minori know that her surprise was a success.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, shall we start heading over to our final destination? Probably shouldn't make them wait too long.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sounds good.
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Where are they? Where are they?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They said that they're near the arcade machines at the back, so probably somewhere around here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There they are. Over...hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! Akito and Toya are here too♪
Wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming, Azusawa, Shiraishi.
Um...and you too, Aoyagi, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry for coming unannounced.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I heard from Azusawa and Shiraishi that they're going to be celebrating your birthday, so I wanted to wish you a happy birthday at the very least.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I just tagged along.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But isn't this so much better? The more, the merrier! C'mon, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kusanagi, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, Akito! You should play some games with us too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like that. Since we're here, why don't we play a game where we verse each other?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I'd like to play “that.” After all, I still haven't beaten you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, “that.” I accept your challenge.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I totally forgot that you were really good at arcade games, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, he's so good! He even got into the rankings for puzzle games.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I heard he was good, but that's quite the achievement.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup. When it comes to competitive games, it's super fun just watching these two battle it out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you ready, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I've been practicing so I think it'll be a tighter match than last time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm looking forward to it.
Alright, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're going down.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, Toya! Good luck♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi. I wasn't able to do much aside from wish you a happy birthday, but I hope you had an amazing day today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nene, I'm so sorry I wasn't able to join you guys! But I'm glad that you enjoyed the surprise birthday cake!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sad that I couldn't say this to you in person, so I'm pouring my soul into your birthday greeting now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy, happy birthday, Nene! I hope this year is a wonderful one for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi! I'm glad I was able to celebrate with you, even if it was just for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. We even took lots of Print Stickers too! Playing video games was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was a really close match too. To be honest, I didn't think it was going to be as tight as it was.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, Kusanagi has always had excellent game sense. With a little more practice, I may not stand a chance next time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You say that, but you seem pretty excited.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait for the next time we all get to play games together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi. I know we practice singing together quite often, but we don't usually hang out like this, so it was a nice change.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think the last time was when we were making candles together. Thank you for a fun day of fluffy animals, good food and the great company.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki wasn't able to come because of work, so let's all go do something together sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Once again, Kusanagi, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem! Here we go.
Three, two, one!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Judging by what Emu told me, it sounds like you had a great birthday celebration with your friends.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've been practicing non-stop lately, so I hope it gave you a breath of fresh air.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup♪ I also had sooo much fun♪
Let's head back into practice tomorrow with smiles all round☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, we'll see you back at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone... Thank you for all of the birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really didn't think there would be this many people celebrating with me and wishing me a happy birthday...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was a little embarrassing at times but... I'm super happy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you so much. I'm going to keep doing my best to make shows that puts smiles on people's faces.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to wake up since I actually managed to get up early.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our next show is gonna be our last one as members of the park's cast.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go with them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go out there and learn as much as I can! And I'm gonna find a way to fill this park with even more smiles!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The four of us are gonna learn as much as we can and become better actors.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And if we can make our dreams come true together...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to do everything I can to achieve that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, then I'll start with the exercises Ms. Kazamatsuri showed me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This might be the most sets I can do. Doing any more is probably going to affect how I practice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ms. Kazamatsuri even said that I shouldn't do more until my body's had a chance to get used to it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (While I'm doing this, others out there are also probably doing their best to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I have to think Tsukasa and Seiryuin are doing even more.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I'm gonna have any hope of catching up to them, I don't have time to sit around.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'll get scolded again if I push myself too hard. I just have to get used to things and keep at it.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Nene, you're here early!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Morning, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Were you doing solo practice all on your own? That's rather unsociable of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's wrong with being alone for solo practice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! Were you having one of those super-secret training sessions?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“No... You mustn't look!
I mean it. You must not look!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Am I supposed to be the crane from that story?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The crane in the story wasn't that obnoxious about it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That could actually make for an interesting twist.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, Nene, your stamina's gone up quite a bit. I'm guessing your core feels a lot stronger now as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You often stood on one leg and even your tip-toes when you played the Cowardly Canary, but your performance felt very natural.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's right. I doubt you would've been able to do that if your core wasn't strong enough.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They noticed what I did then...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That makes me really happy. I worried about what my legs were doing just as much as getting my arms to look like real wings.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
By the way, Nene...
I have a suggestion for you since you've been working so hard. Would you like to hear it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've got that look on your face... I dunno what you're planning, but I...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The thing is, I made some upgrades to the weighted jacket I lent you that one time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I'm telling you I'm good...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But wouldn't it be better to make use of any aids that can help you increase your stamina more efficiently?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, more efficiently you say...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you wear it like a regular jacket? That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-Wait, no!
You two are saying that because neither of you have tried it on...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa, Emu, so you're both interested! In that case, I can bring it by tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, please do!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Don't come crying to me later, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, it is nice knowing that we get to keep goofing off together like this...)
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's the final day for the park's anniversary show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Once it's over, we probably won't be doing any shows here for a while...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hm? Kusanagi, you're here early...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Seiryuin.
Um... Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's nice today, isn't it? The perfect weather for our final showing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, Seiryuin...?
Thanks for agreeing to help us with our show.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I mean, this is the least I can do to ensure that Phoenix Wonderland's anniversary show serves as a proper celebration.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'm going to practice for a bit since we won't be starting for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I...!
I'm really glad that I got to meet an actress like you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought you were amazing when we first met during the show contest.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it felt like I got whacked upside my head when I saw your phoenix...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It honestly felt like we were on completely different levels...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just like you said, I was trying to figure out my role all on my own that time, and I kept telling myself that I had to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But in the end, I had to ask you and Ms. Kazamatsuri for help... Emu and the others also played a pretty big role...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You taught me that I still have a lot of work left to do, and I'm really grateful that you did.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Then, you're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anything else...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There are still a ton of things that I need to learn about and figure out how to do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And it's going to take a lot of time and practice to get it all down.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As an actress, Seiryuin, I don't want to keep falling behind you! I want to learn how to steal the spotlight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, you better be ready for me!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hehe. What a cute declaration.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, wanting to simply steal the spotlight means you're still thinking of yourself as a supporting character. All you're doing is putting your vigor to waste.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Instead, you should be thinking more about stealing the lead from me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Because you won't stand a chance against me unless you try at least that hard.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: And don't even think about trying to turn tail and run.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I won't!
Don't think you'll get to be the lead so easily the next time we do a show together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And thanks for listening to what I had to say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm really glad we got to talk.
I'd been meaning to tell you my intentions.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Likewise. It was nice to hear that you're so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Now, allow me to say this as just Sakurako...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Go. As far as you can. As high as you can.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Because the sky is the limit for you and your troupe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...!
For everything you've done.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is goodbye for now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But let's do another show together someday.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, I'll very much be looking forward to that day.
Instrument Shop

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
They had the CD I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And thanks for coming with me, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No problem, Nene!
I'm glad they had what you were looking for!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too. The lead in this musical has such a beautiful singing voice... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Isn't that Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, you're right!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Shiiho, surprise!
Good wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Otori?!
And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's been a while, Kusanagi...
What brings you two here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We came to get a CD Nene wanted!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we just found it, so we were thinking about going somewhere to hang out☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did you also come here to buy something, Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, nothing in particular.
I had some free time, so I decided to check out a few instruments.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wonder if it's the norm for people in bands to come check out instruments after school... I think that's pretty cool...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I was just about to head home since I've seen basically all of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we should all go somewhere and hang out together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, right now...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I tried to think of where we could go next while Nene looked at the CDs...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's when I remembered that this cute cafe on the way home that sells animal-shaped donuts just opened!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really want you two to see it because it's super adorable! So, let's go☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene, did you hear?!
Shiho and I are in the same class!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You must've told me at least ten times by now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Because I'm super happy about it!
It's my chance to get to know her even better!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I can't say that makes me unhappy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Emu has a point. Hinomori always seems so calm...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And it was really fun when we got to sing together... I bet we'd get along if we were in the same class.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Although maybe I'm only thinking that since my class is full of extroverts...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, Kusanagi, I heard that Shiraishi and a couple of her teammates also attend Kamiyama High.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did you end up in the same class as any of them?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, both Shiraishi and Shinonome are in my class...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Then, you probably talk to them a lot, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, not really...
Their personalities are just too different from mine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's like trying to mix oil with water...
I doubt I'd be able to hold a long conversation or become friends with them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you're overthinking things...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You and Otori seem plenty different to me, but you're close enough to hang out all the time after school and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho

It says “Happy birthday, Nene!”
Is this...

rows.Line:
A surprise?
Ah! Something popped out!

rows.Line: Hehe, what a packed schedule. You work hard at practice every day, so I hope you can relax and enjoy yourself today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I will!
A few hours later
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The meetup spot should be right around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heeey, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, everyone. Did I keep you waiting?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not at all! Airi and I just got here a tiny bit ago!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to today for so long. Let's all have plenty of fun together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I never thought I'd be spending my birthday with so many people.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for reaching out to everyone, Emu. And looking up everything about the festival, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! I was just doing my duty as the leader of the Nene Birthday Squad!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yet another new squad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, because you, and Honami and everyone else, are all here to celebrate Nene's birthday☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That we are! We'll celebrate with everything we've got, Captain!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now that our special guest has arrived... Let's go to the festival☆
Festival Grounds

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here we are!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd heard this festival was on the smaller side, but there are a good number of stalls set up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They all look so much fun, I can't decide where to go first. Is there anything you want to do, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that shooting booth looks like fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shooting, huh? There's no line right now, so sounds good to me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Let's have a rooty-shooty contest!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...I missed again. This is harder than it looks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I haven't hit a single target either!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It never goes where I want it to. Maybe I'm holding the gun at the wrong angle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look at that. Kusanagi's on a streak...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There... That's four.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're awesome, Nene☆ You're like a real sniper!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're exaggerating. I've just been aiming at the easy targets, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right, you're amazing! We haven't even hit anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is there some trick to it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... I guess just make sure you line the gun up properly with your sightline. That's how a sniper would do it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh, I see! Like this, Master Kusanagi?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Raise the barrel a tiny bit... Right, like that. Now aim just above the prize you want.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hah!
Wow, I hit it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, that was great☆
Teach me too, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, sure.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're really good at teaching, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Yoyo Fishing Stall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh, look! I got a water balloon yoyo!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I got one too... Huh? I think we got the same pattern, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, look at that! I wanna match with Nene, too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why don't we all aim for the same pattern? It can be proof of the bonds of the Nene Birthday Squad♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's a lovely idea. Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see, the same pattern as Kusanagi's...ah, there. It's small, but if I can just hook it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So close! You almost had it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your hook slipped at the last second. But your line didn't snap, so you can try again.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You can do it, Mochizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-da! My very own matching yoyo☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good job, Emu! Now we all have matching yoyos.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Operation Match With Nene is a success!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! Why don't we all take a photo together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That sounds nice. I'll be in the back...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, surround Nene and get in real close!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, let's get everyone in the frame... Perfect.
Here goes! Say cheese!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think that's the last stall we wanted to check out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Those caramel apples we got sure were tasty.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I could tell you were debating getting a second one, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, well, this seems like a good time to wrap...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Not so fast!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We just so happen to have a surprise for you!
