rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aaand... Here, Nene! This is a present from me and Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a beige beret. We thought it would really suit you, so we hope you'll wear it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A beret... Thank you very much. I'd never think to buy one for myself, so I'm really happy you got it for me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We actually have a present for you too, Kusanagi. Here—it's a stainless steel water bottle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's easy to carry, so it'll be handy during practice or when you're running.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, thanks. It's really light, too. I'll start using it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And last, from me! With all my wishes for us to keep up the good work...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a matching knitted kitty pouch☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, this is just like the one you have.
The kitty embroidery is so cute...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's keep up the good work, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks so much for today. Going around the stalls with everyone, even getting presents... It was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you had a good time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're having a party with Tsukasa and the others after this, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right. He said to message him when we leave the festival.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're really enjoying the day, huh? Be sure to make lots of fun memories.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks very much. And thank you too, Mochizuki, Hinomori. I had lots of fun hanging out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had lots of fun, too. Let's hang out again soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I hope Hoshino and Tenma can make it then, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, Nene! I got a message from Tsukasa! He wants us to come to this address!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. Looks like we should go, everyone. Thanks again, and see you soon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: See you! Bye bye!
Rental Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow. Tsukasa rented a pretty big room for this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?! The lights—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?! Hoshino? Tenma?!
What are you doing here? I thought you had plans...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We finished faster than we thought. And Saki said that if we hurried, we could still make it to your party.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I messaged Tsukasa, and said we'd be joining last-minute!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What a surprise, right?! A birthday is best with as many surprises as possible, after all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't get to take credit for it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm really glad you two could make it. Thank you both.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And with Nene here, I believe it's time we get this party started.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! If everyone could gather around the cake!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, it looks so tasty! Look at all the grapefruit on top!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, you're right. Did you all prepare this too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! We wanted it to be a cake you would love, so we looked for one made with grapefruit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We also have birthday candles and tiny sparklers. Also regular fireworks, if you prefer.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, no thanks. But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys got this space, the cake...you even decorated for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So...you know. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No need to thank us. Today is the birthday of a dear friend and comrade, after all!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. This is your day, Nene. Please let us celebrate you in every way we can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi. Emu sent us the photos from the festival. It looks like you all had a great time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This one of you all with matching yoyos really feels like a snapshot of youth! I hope I can join you all next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We saw one of you at the shooting stall, too. There's something about your eyes in that one... You look super focused, like a sniper.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't have much experience with shooting booths... But I might be able to take you on in a video game. I hope we'll get a chance to try soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I heard about the festival trip from Ms. Mochizuki. It sounds like you had fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You summer babies are lucky, getting to go to festivals for your birthday. There's never much exciting going on around my birthday, so I'm a bit envious.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sounds like it'll be a great memory!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right, Kusanagi! I got you a present, so I'll visit your class to give it to you! As for what's inside... You'll find out when you get it♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once again! Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm really glad we got to hang out. If you're free, let's grab a bite together sometime♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh, I want to join! I found a cafe that serves grapefruit juice the other day. And it's all fresh-squeezed!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure you'd like it, Nene! Let's all go together soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Everyone ready? One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad we could celebrate your birthday with you. And I'm very glad you liked your present, too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were just hanging out today, but I hope we can make it to one of your shows sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna go! I really love your singing voice, Nene! It's so beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel the same way. And as an actress, you're so good at putting emotion into it... I feel like I learn so much watching you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, Kusanagi. Now that your training schedule has settled down, let's practice singing together again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee! Happy happy birthday!!! I had so much fun hanging out with you today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It sounds like the show in SEKAI was a big success, as well. I hope it's been a very memorable day for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seemed like you enjoyed the cake and decorations, and the surprise magic show too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, Nene was super smiley the whole time! It made me all happy, too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Let us continue to spend our days together, overflowing with smiles, just like today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all for celebrating my birthday with me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I put on a show with Miku and the others, went to a festival with friends...and even had a birthday party thrown for me. Today has been so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After getting all these smiles from everyone, I'll have to repay them plenty.
Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh, ahem!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Today was originally intended to be a celebration for the end of the ArcLand workshop...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But with our decision to participate in the contest, it is now a kickoff party, effective immediately!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's put together the greatest show we can, and win glory upon the stage at the Center Theatre!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's do it, everyone!
Won-won hip-hip-hooray!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hooray!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, this is an amazing opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even just participating in the workshop taught us so much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And to think, now we might even have a chance to perform for real!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah! I'm all fired up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And the contest's theme is ArcLand's motto, “anyone can be a princess”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This contest may not be for the public eye, but it's a true honor to work with this theme at ArcLand itself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's exciting, but it makes me nervous too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of ArcLand's princess shows are amazing. We'll have to work really hard not to look terrible by comparison.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, all their princesses are so pretty and sparkly and wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I always wanted to be an ArcLand princess...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Princesses really do have that kind of magnetism.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Especially when you're little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember begging my mom to get me a princess ballgown when I was young.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course, a ballgown was too much... But she did buy me a frilly dress to make up for it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Swishing the skirt around really made me feel like a princess... I still remember how happy it made me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When Saki was little, she used to absolutely adore any storybooks I read her with princesses in them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe everyone wants to be a princess at least a little bit, deep down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps that's why ArcLand has become famous the world over for its motto.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, hey! Do you have any pictures of you from back then, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh... Pictures?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Pictures of Princess Nene! I just know you were super cute!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I don't know about that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah. You're looking rather evasive, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, shut up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe we may have one or two pictures of Nene like that at home.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What the heck?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I produced a show involving a princess when I was young, and I had Nene play the role of the princess.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She was so happy to be a princess, in fact, that she wore the toy tiara for the rest of the day and seemed very pleased with herself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, you're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't believe you remember that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My mother took pictures of the show for us, so the photos should still be somewhere at home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hooray! You'll have to show us next time, Rui! And tell us all kinds of cute stories about little Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, there's—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, alright.
I'm afraid that's all I can offer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, to think there was such an anecdote about Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe we should build our show for the contest around a princess, played by our expert Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna see Nene play a princess!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This contest is really important, okay? We can't decide on it just like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Honestly...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Oh, my prince...! My beloved! Take me from this place, and I'll stay by your side, wherever you may go!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “And so the prince and princess were married. And they all lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “However, this is where our story begins. What comes after 'happily ever after'?”
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? What are you two looking at?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shhh, keep quiet. Nene is practicing for the contest. Len, Rin and Miku are reading lines for her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A story that starts after the prince and princess get married. Rui always thinks of such interesting things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Still...
*Sigh*
Today is the tenth day...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “It's been ten whole days since I've seen his face!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “My, my, your Highness! If you want to see Prince Blesse so badly, you could pay him a visit yourself instead of working so diligently.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I suppose that's true... But somehow, the idea annoys me.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “He used to say such beautiful things about loving me forever and whatnot, but he hasn't paid me a single visit lately.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, this princess is so much fun. She's so expressive and lively.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Nene's really making full use of her acting range. The character is pretty likeable too, so it's easy to sympathize with her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But the mood starts getting more serious from here on.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “It's been so long since you took me on a date. I almost thought you'd never come to see me again.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “I do feel bad about that. But I've realized now that being with you is more important than anything else.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Let's spend all day together, as long as we like. I promise it'll be a great day.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Right. I'm looking forward to it...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Huh?! Cursed?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“I see... So that's why...!
Oh, why didn't I see it sooner?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “No, that's not important. Good Fairy! How do we undo the curse?”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “There's only one way.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew... Thanks for helping me out, everyone. Running through so many scenes must have been tiring.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No way, not at all! We're happy to help anytime☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, you were watching?
What did you think?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Princess Harte sulks over being forgotten, is overjoyed to go on a date and fights to break the curse...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Her warm and kind personality is always there at the core of her character, but in each scene, you showed so many different sides to her. It was very impressive.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It looked great to me! I'd call it perfect already.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I get the feeling I'm not digging deep enough yet. If I could understand her better, I think I could do more.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You mean, you're still not satisfied?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're putting this on for ArcLand, after all. It's just not there yet...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You really think so? I think you're doing very well, though...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? Well, maybe I've improved a little after all that training.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... The pressure's weighing on me for sure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Princesses are very important to ArcLand. They're central to the park's whole concept.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see... I can totally understand how that would make you nervous!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've been watching a lot of recordings of ArcLand's old shows, hoping to get some references for princess roles...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And every princess is so charming.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even in the toughest circumstances, they have the strength to make it through...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Each one is brilliant, like they light up the whole story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seeing ArcLand's actresses bring those princesses to life drives it home that they're on a whole different level from me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But, well... That's exactly why this is a role I want to challenge myself with.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to work harder if I want to play a princess like them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay☆
We're gonna do everything we can to support you, full power!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm totally good for more practice!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ooh, can I join in too?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
Can we run through it again from the top, then?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Even in the toughest circumstances, they have the strength to make it through...”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “Each one is brilliant, like they light up the whole story.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looking at her now, I feel like Nene embodies those words already.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She does. And I'm sure she'll show us plenty of brilliant princesses in plenty of different stories.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can hardly wait!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, places! Here we go!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene! That was so so sooooo great!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was. You were concerned about the leadup and entry into the chorus, but the depth of your emotion really brought the scene to life before my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean that? I worked the hardest on that part, so I'm really glad to hear it.
Neneee! Miku! KAITOOO!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not even the time we agreed upon, and you're already here practicing on your own!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. That's why you're here too, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! Daily diligence is critical for a future star such as myself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. I came to practice my singing too♪ And we just ran into Rui and Robo-Nene over there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Though, I'm here to unveil Robo-Nene's newest function.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Miku
rows.Line:
A new function?
A new function?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? Rui, I let you take her because you told me she needed her regular maintenance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wish you wouldn't make that face. This function partially serves to protect Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Protect her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes! You see, Robo-Nene is equipped with both an anti-toppling mechanism and an impact-dampening mechanism that guards against damage in the event of a tumble...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And today, I've revamped the impact-dampening mechanism. Robo-Nene is finally equipped with her own airbags!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a test... Oh, Tsukasa. From where you're standing, would you mind charging straight into Robo-Nene at full force?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let me just...refuse, obviously! Robo-Nene may be fine because of her airbags, but what about me?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course... Hmm, I was hoping to get some practical data now that it's finished, but...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
There's a sound.
It's coming from above.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Above?
Whoooaaa! I'm faaalliiing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ahhh! Someone's falling towards us!!
Somebody green... Is it one of the plushies?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What was a plushie doing up in the sky?
Actually, that doesn't look like anyone I've seen around SE—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A chance to experiment!
Ah, rather... Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes! I'll act as a cushion with my airbag attachment!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Confirming velocity and point of impact... 3...2...1... Engage!
Bwuh?!
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! Nicely done, Robo-Nene! You made a fine cushion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, are you alright?
Ouchie... I-I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Nice to meetcha! I'm Kuchipatchi! Did you guys save me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our friend Robo-Nene there sent you all poof-boing with her airbags!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whoa! Thanks so much!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm glad you seem to be uninjured.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, why were you plummeting from the sky?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're not one of the plushies from this SEKAI, so I assume you wandered in from somewhere else...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Oh, right! I came here 'cause I heard some really pretty singing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, singing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm... I'll attempt to summarize what you've told us, Kuchipatchi...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Firstly, you've come here from a place called Tamagotchi Planet, which exists somewhere in our universe, or perhaps another one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I say you've “come here”, but it seems you're actually in a dream under the effects of the sleep-learning machine your tama friend Mametchi invented.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You were supposed to hear a sample performance of your choir piece when you used the machine, but for some reason, you heard Nene singing instead...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: It was so pretty, it took my breath away!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you... Still, what a rough day for you.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whaddaya mean?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? I mean, I know it's just a dream, but you're in a new place all on your own, right?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
But I'm happy I got to meet the girl who was singing!
Uhh... Can I call you Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. Let's keep it casual, Kuchipatchi.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!!!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Hehehe. Great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, this is hardly a good position for you to be in.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. If you at least knew a way to get home...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Kuchipatchi, did Mametchi tell you what to do in an emergency? Is there a way to cut the sleep-learning machine's power?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
Cut it? Uhh...
Oh, I know how to cut cake or bread!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's not going to help.
You don't want to be lost like this forever, do you?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! I'm lost!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You just realized that now?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Should I call you absent-minded, or laid-back...?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do?! If I don't go home, I can't eat any home cooking!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, is that all you're worried about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've pegged you as a glutton, Kuchipatchi...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you have that big choir recital, right? You and your friends were practicing for it together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can't we do something, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: About that. From what I've heard, it should simply be a matter of Kuchipatchi waking up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. You did say you're dreaming right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It then becomes a question of when you're going to wake...
Kuchipatchi, did you set an alarm for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Nope. But somebody at home should wake me up when it's morning!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, it sounds like we had nothing to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, hey, Kuchipatchi! Until morning comes, you should stay here and play with us!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Can I?! I was looking at the Ferris wheel!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Huh...? What's that big tent over there?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's where we put on shows.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Shows? The kind where you sing and dance?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right. Actually, the four of us also put on shows as a troupe called Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whoa...! Oh, so that's why you were singing, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: I know...! Nene, everybody! I wanna learn how to sing from you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For that recital with your group?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Yeah... See, I think it's my fault we didn't sound good together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: When we start singing, and in the middle too, I keep falling behind before I know it.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: That's why I wanted to get better at it with the machine Mametchi made for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Everybody's been practicing so hard. I'll be a real bother if I'm still bad tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Kuchipatchi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, say no more!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's all help Kuchipatchi get super great at singing♪

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
...!
Y-You'll really teach me?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I can definitely relate to wanting to do your best for your friends.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So let's do it together, Kuchipatchi!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys! I'm ready to learn!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then! Let's begin Kuchipatchi's Super Special Practice Session!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whoo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll sing with you and cheer you on!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: You mean it? I feel better already!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's fine and all, but... Isn't “Super Special Practice Session” an awkward name? It's kinda hard to say.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe so, but it reflects Tsukasa's personality rather well, wouldn't you say? And the promise of improvement feels genuine.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, Nene! I've got my serious face on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No problem. I'm looking forward to it too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahh, what a dignified expression! Our friend is overflowing with motivation!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh... I guess I can see it...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Everybody's been practicing so hard. I'll be a real bother if I'm still bad tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to honor Kuchipatchi's feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, let's get started. First, the basics!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Put your hands over your belly button... If you have one... Then breathe in slowly through your nose. Try to imagine filling your belly up with air so it sticks out.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi & Miku
rows.Line: *Inhale*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you breathe out, take about twice the time it took to breathe in. While you're doing that, your belly should shrink back down.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi & Miku
rows.Line: *Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: P-Pbbbt... Pbbt... Pbbbbbbt...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh! You've got it, you've got it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You just did a lip trill. Once you've got the hang of it, let's try changing your pitch during it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll practice humming next. There's a bit of a trick to this... Tsukasa, can you demonstrate?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Leave it to me! Ahem...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hummmm...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: It sounds like he's just saying “hmmm”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, he isn't using his throat, but his nasal cavity... That sound is coming from inside his nose.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Huh?! His nose?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Kuchipatchi, can you put one hand on your neck...area, and one by your nose? You'll be able to feel the vibrations better, which should make it easier to practice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Next up may be our main challenge... We're going to work on your rhythm.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: The Nenetronome is at the ready. Set the time signature and tempo, and it will sound automatically.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Nenetronome...? Is that a metronome? I didn't realize she had that function.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. It's convenient since you can just tell her what to set it to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, let's hear 4/4 at sixty bpm.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to get a grasp of your rhythm sense, so let's start with clapping practice.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Alright! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great job, Kuchipatchi! You practiced so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's see the results of our Super Special Practice Session!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: I-I'm so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't worry. Try to remember the breathing we practiced. Relax, and let your tension melt away.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
*Inhale*
*Exhale*
*Inhale*
*Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Okay, here goes...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (You're vocalizing properly, and you've got the rhythm right too!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That means all that's left is...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were sooooo good, Kuchipatchi♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even when Nene joined in partway through, you didn't get distracted and continued to sing well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means you're able to listen out for what those around you are doing! In which case, you should do a fine job singing with your friends as well.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really. Didn't you feel it yourself, Kuchipatchi? Our two voices really melded together into one there.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: You're right, I did...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
As long as you remember that sensation, everything will go great.
And try to keep doing those basic exercises too, if you can.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: You got it, Ms. Nene!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is it, Kuchipatchi? You suddenly seem distracted...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: I hear singing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Singing...?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
Oh! I know this voice! I know the song too!
It's gotta be Mametchi! Mametchi's singing with somebody!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Hey, Mametchi! Where're you at? I'm right here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't hear anything, though...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Huh?! B-But it's totally Mametchi!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your friend must be calling for you, Kuchipatchi!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes... Mametchi likely realized that someone's song brought you here, and had the idea to guide you in the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: H-How do I answer?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You just need to sing back. But...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: But...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We have to say bye bye before you can go there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu & Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We got to be such good friends, and we already have to say goodbye?!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: No way! I wanna keep playing and talking with you gu—

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
...
But, I bet Mametchi's worried about me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're probably right... Mametchi could be out there singing very hard for you and the friends you both treasure, so you can all see each other again.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
...
I'm gonna go see Mametchi!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Thanks so much for doing that super special singing practice session with me, you guys! I'll give that recital all I've got!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good...! I'm sure you'll do great, Kuchipatchi!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Kuchipatchi's supposed to answer with song, yes? In that case, we'll have to join in to see this through!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
Yeah!
Of course!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Y-You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh... There's a light coming from Kuchipatchi...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This really is goodbye.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can tell you're having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to say my goodbye with a smile too.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...! Kuchipatchi...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bye bye, Kuchipatchi!!! I had so so sooo much fun singing with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are we never gonna see each other again...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Kuchipatchi comes from someplace far out of reach... Normally, I think that would be the case.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However... I somehow get the feeling that this isn't the end of our story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll meet again?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As short as your time together was, I'd say a real bond was forged today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, if you ask me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seems a certainty that your song, your feelings and your bond will bring you all together again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I see. Our chances sound quite high indeed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! Nene, we might get to see Kuchipatchi again!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (When we do, Kuchipatchi, let's sing more together!)
